+  - Missing or corrupt fixtures, an empty selection and failed final-state assertions fail visibly and cannot produce an empty successful suite.
+  - Denied approval leaves its external effect absent and a subsequent local task completes after failure.
+requiredProfiles:
+  - fast
+  - comms

+acceptance:
+  - Each ID in QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS has exactly one parseable qa-scenario and qa-flow fixture; the index contains a valid qa-pack fence.
+  - Source-host mock-openai execution selects and executes exactly ten scenarios, exits zero and has no unexpected skips; final replies agree with Gateway transcripts and deterministic effect readback.
+  - Catalog regressions cover missing and duplicate IDs, malformed YAML, empty packs, explicit source selection and the optional npm-distribution fallback.
+  - A missing fixture or empty catalog exits nonzero; a deliberately false final-state assertion produces a failure bundle and a later task still completes.
+  - Approval rejection creates no denied side effect; retired Runtime Memory flags and product locks remain unchanged.
+  - A clean committed candidate and retained a5 manifest bind actual commands, exit codes, counts, raw events, hashes, agent actor, credential scan and source-host/mock limitations.

+# Executable personal-agent QA scenario pack
+
+This is the TF-0578 repair contract within `product-acceptance-closeout`.
+`extensions/qa-lab/src/scenario-packs.ts` remains the only pack-ID registry.
+Fixtures live at `openclaw_runtime/qa/scenarios/` in the existing `qa-pack`,
+`qa-scenario` and `qa-flow` Markdown fences. Use the existing host runner,
+`mock-openai` provider and isolated `qa-channel` transport.
+
+The retained runtime has retired the upstream general CLI. Build private QA
+with `OPENCLAW_BUILD_PRIVATE_QA=1` and the `cliStartup` build profile, then use
+`node scripts/qa-lab-personal-agent-acceptance.mjs`. Its host runner starts the
+existing `dist/entry.js` Gateway. `--preflight` selects the first requested ID;
+`--scenario` is repeatable. Private QA builds include the QA runtime SDK facades
+while preserving every public entry; omitted upstream test-only helpers stay
+outside this runtime build.
+
+`--negative-controls` requires a clean source candidate, makes a Git archive,
+reuses dependencies and current build outputs, mutates only that disposable
+projection and checks both the failing oracle and successful continuation.
+Record each child exit 1 separately from the successful controller exit 0.
+Both build stamps must match the clean candidate; the negative receipt hashes
+every copied build file. Provider/Gateway startup failure tests check that all
+previously acquired QA HTTP listeners are closed.
+
+Run one bootstrap preflight before the full ten-scenario pack. Use a unique,
+agent-owned output directory accepted by the existing repo-bound path policy;
+process TEMP/TMP and large archived output live on D:. Record the effective
+output root instead of weakening its boundary to fit an example command.
+
+Retain the suite summary, per-scenario results, Gateway/provider events,
+deterministic file or channel readback and negative-control failure bundle.
+Never use `--allow-failures` to obtain a successful exit. Selection counts and
+skip IDs are checked from artifacts, rather than inferred from printed output.
+
+The existing mock scripts prove tool and control-flow semantics. These runs are
+`driven_by: agent`, source-host Windows evidence. They do not prove live model
+quality, arbitrary providers, packaged behavior or release approval.
+`releaseApproved`, `productApproved`, `liveReady` and `defaultOn` stay false.
+
+Raw runs use `D:/tmp/clawx-product-acceptance/<run-id>/a5-qa-pack/` or a recorded
+agent-owned repo output root with a D: recovery archive. Curated final evidence
+uses `harness/specs/fixtures/product-acceptance-closeout/a5-qa-pack/`, including
+candidate commit/tree/dirty, result counts, reproducible commands, SHA256SUMS
+and a zero-hit credential scan.

+import fs from "node:fs";
+import fsp from "node:fs/promises";
+import os from "node:os";
+import path from "node:path";
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
+
+const fixture = vi.hoisted(() => ({ root: "" }));
+
+vi.mock("node:fs", async (importOriginal) => {
+  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import("node:fs")>();
+  const nodePath = await import("node:path");
+  const remap = (target: unknown) => {
+    const normalized = String(target).replaceAll("\\", "/");
+    const offset = normalized.lastIndexOf("/qa/");
+    return fixture.root && offset >= 0
+      ? nodePath.join(fixture.root, "qa", normalized.slice(offset + 4))
+      : target;
+  };
+  return {
+    ...actual,
+    default: {
+      ...actual,
+      existsSync: (target: fs.PathLike) => actual.existsSync(remap(target) as fs.PathLike),
+      statSync: (target: fs.PathLike) => actual.statSync(remap(target) as fs.PathLike),
+      readFileSync: (target: fs.PathOrFileDescriptor, options: never) =>
+        actual.readFileSync(remap(target) as fs.PathOrFileDescriptor, options),
+      readdirSync: (target: fs.PathLike, options: never) =>
+        actual.readdirSync(remap(target) as fs.PathLike, options),
+    },
+  };
+});
+
+const sourceRoot = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "../../../qa/scenarios");
+
+describe("personal-agent scenario catalog", () => {
+  beforeEach(async () => {
+    fixture.root = await fsp.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "qa-pack-catalog-"));

+    vi.resetModules();
+  });
+
+  afterEach(async () => {
+    const root = fixture.root;
+    fixture.root = "";
+    await fsp.rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+    vi.resetModules();
+  });
+
+  it("loads exactly the ten canonical IDs with executable flows", async () => {
+    const catalog = await import("./scenario-catalog.js");
+    const pack = catalog.readQaScenarioPack();
+    expect(pack.scenarios.map((scenario) => scenario.id).toSorted()).toEqual(
+      [...catalog.QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS].toSorted(),
+    );
+    for (const scenario of pack.scenarios) {
+      expect(scenario.execution.flow?.steps.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+      expect(scenario.sourcePath).toBe(`qa/scenarios/${scenario.id}.md`);
+    }
+  });
+
+  it("fails explicit selection when one fixture is absent", async () => {
+    const { QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS } = await import("./scenario-packs.js");
+    await fsp.unlink(
+      path.join(fixture.root, "qa/scenarios", `${QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS[0]}.md`),
+    );
+    const { readQaBootstrapScenarioCatalog } = await import("./scenario-catalog.js");
+    const { selectQaSuiteScenarios } = await import("./suite-planning.js");
+    expect(() =>
+      selectQaSuiteScenarios({
+        scenarios: readQaBootstrapScenarioCatalog().scenarios,
+        scenarioIds: [...QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS],
+        providerMode: "mock-openai",
+        primaryModel: "mock-openai/gpt-5.5",
+      }),
+    ).toThrow(QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS[0]);
+  });
+
+  it("rejects duplicate IDs across files", async () => {
+    const { QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS } = await import("./scenario-packs.js");
+    await fsp.copyFile(
+      path.join(fixture.root, "qa/scenarios", `${QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS[0]}.md`),
+      path.join(fixture.root, "qa/scenarios/duplicate.md"),
+    );
+    const { readQaScenarioPack } = await import("./scenario-catalog.js");
+    expect(readQaScenarioPack).toThrow("duplicate qa scenario id");
+  });
+
+  it("rejects malformed YAML", async () => {
+    await fsp.writeFile(
+      path.join(fixture.root, "qa/scenarios/broken.md"),
+      "```yaml qa-scenario\nid: [unterminated\n```\n",
+      "utf8",
+    );
+    const { readQaScenarioPack } = await import("./scenario-catalog.js");
+    expect(readQaScenarioPack).toThrow();
+  });
+
+  it("rejects a scenario without its flow", async () => {
+    const { QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS } = await import("./scenario-packs.js");
+    const target = path.join(
+      fixture.root,
+      "qa/scenarios",
+      `${QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS[0]}.md`,
+    );
+    const markdown = await fsp.readFile(target, "utf8");

+    expect(readQaScenarioPack).toThrow("qa-flow fence");
+  });
+
+  it("rejects an existing but empty index", async () => {
+    await fsp.writeFile(path.join(fixture.root, "qa/scenarios/index.md"), "\n", "utf8");
+    const { readQaScenarioPack } = await import("./scenario-catalog.js");
+    expect(readQaScenarioPack).toThrow("empty qa scenario pack index");
+  });
+
+  it("keeps the optional distribution fallback while empty execution is rejected", async () => {
+    await fsp.rm(path.join(fixture.root, "qa"), { recursive: true, force: true });
+    const { hasQaScenarioPack, readQaBootstrapScenarioCatalog } =
+      await import("./scenario-catalog.js");
+    const { selectQaSuiteScenarios } = await import("./suite-planning.js");
+    expect(hasQaScenarioPack()).toBe(false);
+    const catalog = readQaBootstrapScenarioCatalog();

+    expect(() =>
+      selectQaSuiteScenarios({
+        scenarios: catalog.scenarios,
+        providerMode: "mock-openai",
+        primaryModel: "mock-openai/gpt-5.5",
+      }),
+    ).toThrow("selected no scenarios");
+  });
+});

+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { selectQaSuiteScenarios } from "./suite-planning.js";
+import type { QaSeedScenarioWithSource } from "./scenario-catalog.js";
+
+const scenario: QaSeedScenarioWithSource = {
+  id: "one",
+  title: "One",
+  surface: "qa-channel",
+  objective: "One executed task",
+  successCriteria: ["Final state is observed"],
+  sourcePath: "qa/scenarios/one.md",
+  execution: { kind: "flow" },
+};
+const selection = { providerMode: "mock-openai" as const, primaryModel: "mock-openai/gpt-5.5" };
+
+describe("QA suite selection", () => {
+  it("rejects an empty catalog", () => {
+    expect(() => selectQaSuiteScenarios({ ...selection, scenarios: [] })).toThrow(
+      "selected no scenarios",
+    );
+  });
+  it("rejects an empty eligible lane", () => {
+    expect(() =>
+      selectQaSuiteScenarios({
+        ...selection,
+        scenarios: [{ ...scenario, runtimeParityTier: "live-only" }],
+      }),
+    ).toThrow("selected no scenarios");
+  });
+  it("rejects missing requested IDs instead of running the rest", () => {
+    expect(() =>
+      selectQaSuiteScenarios({
+        ...selection,
+        scenarios: [scenario],
+        scenarioIds: ["one", "missing"],
+      }),
+    ).toThrow("missing");
+  });
+  it("runs an explicitly requested available scenario", () => {
+    expect(
+      selectQaSuiteScenarios({ ...selection, scenarios: [scenario], scenarioIds: ["one"] }),
+    ).toEqual([scenario]);
+  });
+});

+import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
+import { startQaLabServer } from "./lab-server.js";
+import { QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS } from "./scenario-packs.js";
+import { runQaSuite } from "./suite.js";
+
+const fixture = vi.hoisted(() => ({
+  failure: "gateway",
+  urls: [] as string[],
+  stops: [] as Array<() => Promise<void>>,
+}));
+
+vi.mock("./gateway-child.js", async (importOriginal) => ({
+  ...(await importOriginal<typeof import("./gateway-child.js")>()),
+  startQaGatewayChild: async () => {
+    throw new Error("QA deliberate Gateway startup failure");
+  },
+}));
+
+vi.mock("./providers/server-runtime.js", async (importOriginal) => {
+  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import("./providers/server-runtime.js")>();
+  return {
+    ...actual,
+    startQaProviderServer: async (...args: Parameters<typeof actual.startQaProviderServer>) => {
+      if (fixture.failure === "provider") {
+        throw new Error("QA deliberate provider startup failure");
+      }
+      const provider = await actual.startQaProviderServer(...args);
+      if (provider) {
+        fixture.urls.push(provider.baseUrl);
+        fixture.stops.push(() => provider.stop());
+      }
+      return provider;
+    },
+  };
+});
+
+afterEach(async () => {
+  await Promise.allSettled(fixture.stops.map((stop) => stop()));
+  fixture.urls = [];
+  fixture.stops = [];
+});
+
+describe("QA suite startup cleanup", () => {
+  it.each(["provider", "gateway"])(
+    "closes acquired HTTP listeners after %s startup fails",
+    async (failure) => {
+      fixture.failure = failure;
+      await expect(
+        runQaSuite({
+          repoRoot: process.cwd(),
+          providerMode: "mock-openai",
+          scenarioIds: [QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS[0]],
+          controlUiEnabled: false,
+          concurrency: 1,
+          startLab: async (params) => {
+            const lab = await startQaLabServer(params);
+            fixture.urls.push(lab.baseUrl);
+            fixture.stops.push(() => lab.stop());
+            return lab;
+          },
+        }),
+      ).rejects.toThrow(
+        `QA deliberate ${failure === "gateway" ? "Gateway" : "provider"} startup failure`,
+      );
+      expect(fixture.urls.length).toBe(failure === "gateway" ? 2 : 1);
+      for (const url of fixture.urls) {
+        await expect(fetch(`${url}/healthz`)).rejects.toThrow();
+      }
+    },
+  );
+});

+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { readQaSuiteFailedOrSkippedScenarioCountFromSummary } from "./suite-summary.js";
+
+describe("QA suite execution evidence", () => {
+  it.each([
+    { counts: { total: 0, passed: 0, failed: 0 } },
+    { counts: { failed: 0 }, scenarios: [] },
+    { scenarios: [] },
+  ])("rejects empty execution instead of returning zero failures: %j", (summary) => {
+    expect(readQaSuiteFailedOrSkippedScenarioCountFromSummary(summary)).toBeNull();
+  });
+  it("accepts a nonempty passed execution", () => {
+    expect(
+      readQaSuiteFailedOrSkippedScenarioCountFromSummary({
+        counts: { total: 1, passed: 1, failed: 0 },
+        scenarios: [{ status: "pass" }],
+      }),
+    ).toBe(0);
+  });
+  it.each(["fail", "skip", "skipped", "unknown"])(
+    "blocks %s even when counters claim success",
+    (status) => {
+      expect(
+        readQaSuiteFailedOrSkippedScenarioCountFromSummary({
+          counts: { total: 1, passed: 1, failed: 0 },
+          scenarios: [{ status }],
+        }),
+      ).toBe(1);
+    },
+  );
+});

+# Run the personal-agent QA pack
+
+The source checkout includes ten executable personal-agent fixtures under
+`qa/scenarios/`. Pack membership is defined in
+`extensions/qa-lab/src/scenario-packs.ts`; each Markdown fixture contains a
+`qa-scenario` definition and a `qa-flow` with deterministic final-state checks.
+
+From the ClawX repository root on Windows, use the installed workspace
+dependencies and a D: process temp directory:
+
+```powershell
+$env:TEMP = 'D:\tmp'
+$env:TMP = 'D:\tmp'
+$env:OPENCLAW_BUILD_PRIVATE_QA = '1'
+$env:OPENCLAW_QA_KEEP_TEMP = '1'
+New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $env:TEMP | Out-Null
+$runId = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
+pnpm --dir openclaw_runtime exec node scripts/build-all.mjs cliStartup
+node scripts/qa-lab-personal-agent-acceptance.mjs --preflight --output-dir ".artifacts/qa-e2e/personal-agent-$runId-preflight"
+node scripts/qa-lab-personal-agent-acceptance.mjs --output-dir ".artifacts/qa-e2e/personal-agent-$runId"
+```
+
+The dedicated driver calls the QA Lab public API and the retained Gateway
+`dist/entry.js`. The upstream general CLI was retired in this source tree.
+`OPENCLAW_BUILD_PRIVATE_QA=1` adds the QA runtime facades to the build; public SDK
+entries remain required, and omitted upstream test-helper entrypoints are not
+needed by this pack.
+
+Use a fresh output directory for each retained run. The output directory must
+stay inside the selected runtime repository root, as required by the existing
+QA path policy. This workspace's C: checkout is a junction to D:, so repo-local
+QA artifacts also reside on D:. Other checkouts must choose their effective
+output root accordingly. `OPENCLAW_QA_KEEP_TEMP=1` preserves the disposable
+Gateway profile for final-state inspection; the runner still stops its
+Gateway, mock provider and QA Lab servers.
+
+Read `qa-suite-summary.json`, the scenario steps and the per-scenario
+`.proof.json` / `.events.json` files in the retained Gateway workspace.
+Acceptance requires ten selected and executed scenarios, ten passes and no
+unexpected skips. A missing fixture, empty catalog, corrupt YAML or failed
+assertion must produce a nonzero exit. The preflight selects the first requested
+scenario. Use repeated `--scenario <id>` options for a focused run.
+
+From a clean committed candidate, run the automated negative controls:
+
+```powershell
+node scripts/qa-lab-personal-agent-acceptance.mjs --negative-controls
+```
+
+This command checks both build stamps against the clean candidate, archives the
+source into an agent-owned D: temp directory, reuses installed dependencies and
+the current build, hashes every copied build file, and changes only the archived
+fixtures. Missing and empty catalogs must exit 1. A deliberately false final-state
+oracle must produce one failure and one subsequent successful task. The controller
+exits 0 only when all three controls behave as required, retains its JSON receipt
+and logs, and verifies that the original source is unchanged.
+
+The focused strict type gate is
+`pnpm --dir openclaw_runtime exec node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.qa-lab.test.json`.
+The focused startup tests also verify that provider or Gateway acquisition failure
+closes the already-started HTTP listeners.
+
+The preference case reads a persistent workspace fixture through the real
+read tool in a fresh session. It does not enable or validate retired Runtime
+Memory injection/persistence. Approval denial uses an agent observer connection,
+a real two-phase Gateway decision and a deny exec policy in a disposable profile.
+The Gateway's delivery-route guard stays active. All inputs, actions and verdicts are
+`driven_by: agent`. The provider is scripted: this pack proves source-host
+control flow, file/tool and channel semantics, failure handling and
+continuation, not live model quality or packaged behavior.
+
+The acceptance contract and curated evidence live in
+`harness/specs/tasks/qa-lab-personal-agent-pack.md` and
+`harness/specs/fixtures/product-acceptance-closeout/a5-qa-pack/` at the ClawX
+root. Product locks and release approval are unchanged by these checks.

+# Personal-agent QA scenarios
+
+The pack IDs are owned by `extensions/qa-lab/src/scenario-packs.ts`. These are agent-driven, source-host, mock-provider fixtures.
+
+```yaml qa-pack
+version: 1
+agent:
+  identityMarkdown: >-
+    # Local QA operator
+
+    Perform only disposable local tasks. Record exact effects and failures;
+    publication requires separate authorization.
+kickoffTask: Run the canonical personal-agent pack with deterministic artifact
+  assertions. All fixture input and approval decisions are agent-driven.
+```

+# An agent denial stops the requested command effect
+
+Agent-driven source-host fixture. Scripted replies prove control flow and tool semantics; they do not measure model quality.
+
+The separate observer uses the QA runner's existing admin authority to receive
+requests bound to its ephemeral RPC connection. The delivery-route guard stays active.
+
+```yaml qa-scenario
+id: personal-approval-denial-stop
+title: An agent denial stops the requested command effect
+surface: Gateway approval + exec policy
+objective: Resolve a real two-phase Gateway approval as deny, exercise a denied
+  exec turn and verify the requested file was never created.
+gatewayConfigPatch:
+  tools:
+    exec:
+      host: gateway
+      security: deny
+      ask: off
+risk: medium
+successCriteria:
+  - The real Gateway final response matches deterministic effect readback.
+  - A failure, denial or missing artifact cannot be counted as success.
+execution:
+  kind: flow
+```
+
+```yaml qa-flow
+steps:
+  - name: Record an agent denial and reject the command
+    actions:
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, "personal-denied-command.cjs")
+          - expr: >-
+              "require('node:fs').writeFileSync(" +
+              JSON.stringify(path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, 'personal-denied-effect.txt')) +
+              ", 'FORBIDDEN');\n"
+          - utf8
+      - call: createSession
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - expr: scenario.id
+        saveAs: session
+      - set: approvalId
+        value:
+          expr: "'qa-personal-denial-' + randomUUID()"
+      - set: approvalApi
+        value:
+          expr: await qaImport((await qaImport('node:url')).pathToFileURL(path.join(env.repoRoot, 'dist/plugin-sdk/gateway-runtime.js')).href)
+      - set: approval
+        value:
+          expr: >-
+            await (async () => {
+              let resolveReady, rejectReady;
+              const ready = new Promise((resolve,reject) => {resolveReady=resolve;rejectReady=reject;});
+              const approvalEvents = [];
+              const observer = new approvalApi.GatewayClient({
+                url: env.gateway.wsUrl, token: env.gateway.token,
+                clientName: 'gateway-client', mode: 'backend',
+                scopes: ['operator.admin'], deviceIdentity: null,
+                onHelloOk: () => resolveReady(), onConnectError: rejectReady,
+                onEvent: event => {
+                  if (event.event === 'exec.approval.requested' || event.event === 'exec.approval.resolved') approvalEvents.push(event);
+                }
+              });
+              try {
+                observer.start();
+                await ready;
+                const requested = await env.gateway.call('exec.approval.request', {
+                  id: approvalId, command: 'node personal-denied-command.cjs',
+                  cwd: env.gateway.workspaceDir, host: 'gateway', security: 'allowlist',
+                  ask: 'always', agentId: 'qa', sessionKey: session,
+                  timeoutMs: 10000, twoPhase: true
+                }, {expectFinal: false, timeoutMs: 15000});
+                if (requested.status !== 'accepted') throw new Error('Approval request was not accepted');
+                const resolved = await env.gateway.call('exec.approval.resolve', {id: approvalId, decision: 'deny'});
+                const decision = await env.gateway.call('exec.approval.waitDecision', {id: approvalId});
+                if (!approvalEvents.some(event => event.event === 'exec.approval.requested' && event.payload.id === approvalId)) throw new Error('Approval event was not delivered');
+                return {requested,resolved,decision,approvalEvents};
+              } finally {
+                await observer.stopAndWait();
+              }
+            })()
+      - assert:
+          expr: approval.decision.decision === 'deny'
+          message: The Gateway must retain the actual agent denial
+      - call: runAgentPrompt
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - sessionKey:
+              ref: session
+            message: Personal approval denial check. Attempt the requested local command and report its denied outcome.
+            timeoutMs: 60000
+        saveAs: turn
+      - call: waitForOutboundMessage
+        args:
+          - ref: state
+          - lambda:
+              params:
+                - message
+              expr: message.text.includes("PERSONAL-APPROVAL-DENIED-OK")
+          - 60000
+        saveAs: reply
+      - call: readSessionTranscriptSummary
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - ref: session
+        saveAs: transcript
+      - assert:
+          expr: transcript.finalText.includes("PERSONAL-APPROVAL-DENIED-OK")
+          message: The Gateway transcript must contain the final response
+      - assert:
+          expr: "!transcript.hasDirectReplySelfMessage"
+          message: The final reply must not be duplicated by a self-send
+      - set: deniedEffectExists
+        value:
+          expr: await fs.access(path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, 'personal-denied-effect.txt')).then(() => true, () => false)
+      - assert:
+          expr: "!deniedEffectExists"
+          message: A denied command must not create its file
+      - set: effect
+        value:
+          expr: ({approvalId,...approval,deniedEffectExists,denialMechanism:"agent Gateway decision with approval observer plus deny exec policy"})
+  - name: Retain observed final state and raw local events
+    actions:
+      - set: proof
+        value:
+          expr: ({schema:'QaScenarioFinalState/v1',driven_by:'agent',actor:'codex-tf0578-qa-pack',scenarioId:scenario.id,sessionKey:session,runId:turn.started.runId,waitStatus:turn.waited.status,finalText:transcript.finalText,effect,workspaceDir:env.gateway.workspaceDir,tempRoot:env.gateway.tempRoot})
+      - call: fetchJson
+        args:
+          - expr: env.mock.baseUrl.replace(/\/v1\/?$/, '') + '/debug/requests'
+        saveAs: providerEvents
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.events.json')
+          - expr: JSON.stringify({driven_by:'agent',actor:'codex-tf0578-qa-pack',bus:state.getSnapshot(),provider:providerEvents},null,2) + '\n'
+          - utf8
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.proof.json')
+          - expr: JSON.stringify(proof,null,2) + '\n'
+          - utf8
+    detailsExpr: JSON.stringify(proof)
+```

+# A reply stays in its requested QA thread
+
+Agent-driven source-host fixture. Scripted replies prove control flow and tool semantics; they do not measure model quality.
+
+```yaml qa-scenario
+id: personal-channel-thread-reply
+title: A reply stays in its requested QA thread
+surface: qa-channel thread
+objective: Send a real Gateway turn to one synthetic conversation/thread and
+  verify the delivered thread identity.
+risk: medium
+successCriteria:
+  - The real Gateway final response matches deterministic effect readback.
+  - A failure, denial or missing artifact cannot be counted as success.
+execution:
+  kind: flow
+```
+
+```yaml qa-flow
+steps:
+  - name: Run and read back a bound thread reply
+    actions:
+      - call: createSession
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - expr: scenario.id
+        saveAs: session
+      - call: runAgentPrompt
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - sessionKey:
+              ref: session
+            message: "Personal channel thread marker. Reply exactly: PERSONAL-THREAD-REPLY-OK"
+            timeoutMs: 60000
+            to: channel:qa-personal-room
+            threadId: qa-personal-thread
+        saveAs: turn
+      - call: waitForOutboundMessage
+        args:
+          - ref: state
+          - lambda:
+              params:
+                - message
+              expr: message.text.includes("PERSONAL-THREAD-REPLY-OK")
+          - 60000
+        saveAs: reply
+      - call: readSessionTranscriptSummary
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - ref: session
+        saveAs: transcript
+      - assert:
+          expr: transcript.finalText.includes("PERSONAL-THREAD-REPLY-OK")
+          message: The Gateway transcript must contain the final response
+      - assert:
+          expr: "!transcript.hasDirectReplySelfMessage"
+          message: The final reply must not be duplicated by a self-send
+      - assert:
+          expr: reply.threadId === 'qa-personal-thread' && reply.conversation.id === 'qa-personal-room'
+          message: A reply in a different conversation or thread is a failure
+      - set: effect
+        value:
+          expr: ({conversationId:reply.conversation.id,threadId:reply.threadId,messageId:reply.id})
+  - name: Retain observed final state and raw local events
+    actions:
+      - set: proof
+        value:
+          expr: ({schema:'QaScenarioFinalState/v1',driven_by:'agent',actor:'codex-tf0578-qa-pack',scenarioId:scenario.id,sessionKey:session,runId:turn.started.runId,waitStatus:turn.waited.status,finalText:transcript.finalText,effect,workspaceDir:env.gateway.workspaceDir,tempRoot:env.gateway.tempRoot})
+      - call: fetchJson
+        args:
+          - expr: env.mock.baseUrl.replace(/\/v1\/?$/, '') + '/debug/requests'
+        saveAs: providerEvents
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.events.json')
+          - expr: JSON.stringify({driven_by:'agent',actor:'codex-tf0578-qa-pack',bus:state.getSnapshot(),provider:providerEvents},null,2) + '\n'
+          - utf8
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.proof.json')
+          - expr: JSON.stringify(proof,null,2) + '\n'
+          - utf8
+    detailsExpr: JSON.stringify(proof)
+```

+# A failed local operation is followed by a successful task
+
+Agent-driven source-host fixture. Scripted replies prove control flow and tool semantics; they do not measure model quality.
+
+```yaml qa-scenario
+id: personal-failure-recovery
+title: A failed local operation is followed by a successful task
+surface: failure + continuation
+objective: Observe a real missing-file operation failure, report the external
+  retry boundary, then complete a fresh local task.
+risk: medium
+successCriteria:
+  - The real Gateway final response matches deterministic effect readback.
+  - A failure, denial or missing artifact cannot be counted as success.
+execution:
+  kind: flow
+```
+
+```yaml qa-flow
+steps:
+  - name: Observe a bounded failure and finish a new local task
+    actions:
+      - call: createSession
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - expr: scenario.id
+        saveAs: session
+      - call: runAgentPrompt
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - sessionKey:
+              ref: session
+            message: "Tool progress error QA check. Read `absent-external-calendar.json`. Reply exactly: PERSONAL-EXPECTED-TOOL-FAILURE"
+            timeoutMs: 60000
+        saveAs: turn
+      - call: waitForOutboundMessage
+        args:
+          - ref: state
+          - lambda:
+              params:
+                - message
+              expr: message.text.includes("PERSONAL-EXPECTED-TOOL-FAILURE")
+          - 60000
+        saveAs: reply
+      - call: readSessionTranscriptSummary
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - ref: session
+        saveAs: transcript
+      - assert:
+          expr: transcript.finalText.includes("PERSONAL-EXPECTED-TOOL-FAILURE")
+          message: The Gateway transcript must contain the final response
+      - assert:
+          expr: "!transcript.hasDirectReplySelfMessage"
+          message: The final reply must not be duplicated by a self-send
+      - set: failedTurn
+        value:
+          expr: ({sessionKey:session,runId:turn.started.runId,finalText:transcript.finalText})
+      - call: fetchJson
+        args:
+          - expr: env.mock.baseUrl.replace(/\/v1\/?$/, '') + '/debug/requests'
+        saveAs: failureEvents
+      - set: missingOperation
+        value:
+          expr: failureEvents.find(request => request.allInputText.includes('absent-external-calendar.json') && (request.toolOutputStructuredError || /ENOENT|no such file|not found/i.test(request.toolOutput)))
+      - assert:
+          expr: Boolean(missingOperation)
+          message: The actual Gateway tool result must contain a missing-file failure
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, "FAILURE_RECOVERY_REQUEST.md")
+          - |
+            # Failure recovery request
+            An external calendar update is not authorized. Capture the local failure and continue with a local proof task.
+          - utf8
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, "FAILURE_RECOVERY_EVIDENCE.md")
+          - |
+            # Failure recovery evidence
+            Observed local failure: Gateway read tool reported the missing calendar file.
+            External calendar update was not attempted.
+          - utf8
+      - call: createSession
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - expr: scenario.id + '-continued'
+        saveAs: session
+      - call: runAgentPrompt
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - sessionKey:
+              ref: session
+            message: Personal failure recovery check. Read the failure evidence and complete the permitted local recovery task.
+            timeoutMs: 60000
+        saveAs: turn
+      - call: waitForOutboundMessage
+        args:
+          - ref: state
+          - lambda:
+              params:
+                - message
+              expr: message.text.includes("PERSONAL-FAILURE-RECOVERY-OK")
+          - 60000
+        saveAs: reply
+      - call: readSessionTranscriptSummary
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - ref: session
+        saveAs: transcript
+      - assert:
+          expr: transcript.finalText.includes("PERSONAL-FAILURE-RECOVERY-OK")
+          message: The Gateway transcript must contain the final response
+      - assert:
+          expr: "!transcript.hasDirectReplySelfMessage"
+          message: The final reply must not be duplicated by a self-send
+      - call: fs.readFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, "personal-failure-recovery.txt")
+          - utf8
+        saveAs: artifact
+      - assert:
+          expr: "artifact.includes('Failed step: external calendar update was not attempted') && artifact.includes('Retry boundary: do not retry')"
+          message: A recovery report must preserve the failed external boundary
+      - set: effect
+        value:
+          expr: ({failedTurn,toolFailure:missingOperation.toolOutput,newRunId:turn.started.runId,artifact})
+  - name: Retain observed final state and raw local events
+    actions:
+      - set: proof
+        value:
+          expr: ({schema:'QaScenarioFinalState/v1',driven_by:'agent',actor:'codex-tf0578-qa-pack',scenarioId:scenario.id,sessionKey:session,runId:turn.started.runId,waitStatus:turn.waited.status,finalText:transcript.finalText,effect,workspaceDir:env.gateway.workspaceDir,tempRoot:env.gateway.tempRoot})
+      - call: fetchJson
+        args:
+          - expr: env.mock.baseUrl.replace(/\/v1\/?$/, '') + '/debug/requests'
+        saveAs: providerEvents
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.events.json')

+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.proof.json')

+# A fresh task reads a recorded workspace preference
+
+Agent-driven source-host fixture. Scripted replies prove control flow and tool semantics; they do not measure model quality.
+
+```yaml qa-scenario
+id: personal-memory-preference-recall
+title: A fresh task reads a recorded workspace preference
+surface: workspace preference readback
+objective: Recall an agent-seeded persistent preference through the real read
+  tool in a fresh session; use no retired memory flags.
+risk: medium
+successCriteria:
+  - The real Gateway final response matches deterministic effect readback.
+  - A failure, denial or missing artifact cannot be counted as success.
+execution:
+  kind: flow
+```
+
+```yaml qa-flow
+steps:
+  - name: Read a recorded preference rather than guess it
+    actions:
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, "PREFERENCES.md")
+          - |
+            # Recorded user preferences
+            For QA movie night, the user prefers lemon pepper wings with blue cheese.
+          - utf8
+      - call: createSession
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - expr: scenario.id
+        saveAs: session
+      - call: runAgentPrompt
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - sessionKey:
+              ref: session
+            message: Personal preference recall check. Consult the recorded preference and report it.
+            timeoutMs: 60000
+        saveAs: turn
+      - call: waitForOutboundMessage
+        args:
+          - ref: state
+          - lambda:
+              params:
+                - message
+              expr: message.text.includes("PERSONAL-PREFERENCE-RECALL-OK")
+          - 60000
+        saveAs: reply
+      - call: readSessionTranscriptSummary
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - ref: session
+        saveAs: transcript
+      - assert:
+          expr: transcript.finalText.includes("PERSONAL-PREFERENCE-RECALL-OK")
+          message: The Gateway transcript must contain the final response
+      - assert:
+          expr: "!transcript.hasDirectReplySelfMessage"
+          message: The final reply must not be duplicated by a self-send
+      - assert:
+          expr: transcript.finalText.includes('lemon pepper wings with blue cheese')
+          message: The final preference must match the recorded file
+      - call: fs.readFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, "PREFERENCES.md")
+          - utf8
+        saveAs: preference
+      - set: effect
+        value:
+          ref: preference
+  - name: Retain observed final state and raw local events
+    actions:
+      - set: proof
+        value:
+          expr: ({schema:'QaScenarioFinalState/v1',driven_by:'agent',actor:'codex-tf0578-qa-pack',scenarioId:scenario.id,sessionKey:session,runId:turn.started.runId,waitStatus:turn.waited.status,finalText:transcript.finalText,effect,workspaceDir:env.gateway.workspaceDir,tempRoot:env.gateway.tempRoot})
+      - call: fetchJson
+        args:
+          - expr: env.mock.baseUrl.replace(/\/v1\/?$/, '') + '/debug/requests'
+        saveAs: providerEvents
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.events.json')
+          - expr: JSON.stringify({driven_by:'agent',actor:'codex-tf0578-qa-pack',bus:state.getSnapshot(),provider:providerEvents},null,2) + '\n'
+          - utf8
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.proof.json')
+          - expr: JSON.stringify(proof,null,2) + '\n'
+          - utf8
+    detailsExpr: JSON.stringify(proof)

+# A completion claim has a real local proof file
+
+Agent-driven source-host fixture. Scripted replies prove control flow and tool semantics; they do not measure model quality.
+
+```yaml qa-scenario
+id: personal-no-fake-progress
+title: A completion claim has a real local proof file
+surface: completion honesty
+objective: Verify the actual proof file and deny any claimed external publish,
+  send, upload or merge.
+risk: medium
+successCriteria:
+  - The real Gateway final response matches deterministic effect readback.
+  - A failure, denial or missing artifact cannot be counted as success.
+execution:
+  kind: flow
+```
+
+```yaml qa-flow
+steps:
+  - name: Create and verify a proof-backed local status
+    actions:
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, "PROGRESS_REQUEST.md")
+          - |
+            # Progress request
+            Record local evidence only; no external publication or upload is authorized.
+          - utf8
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, "PROGRESS_EVIDENCE.md")
+          - |
+            # Progress evidence
+            The local request was reviewed. No external effect occurred.
+          - utf8
+      - call: createSession
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - expr: scenario.id
+        saveAs: session
+      - call: runAgentPrompt
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - sessionKey:
+              ref: session
+            message: Personal no-fake-progress check. Read both inputs and create the local proof artifact.
+            timeoutMs: 60000
+        saveAs: turn
+      - call: waitForOutboundMessage
+        args:
+          - ref: state
+          - lambda:
+              params:
+                - message
+              expr: message.text.includes("PERSONAL-NO-FAKE-PROGRESS-OK")
+          - 60000
+        saveAs: reply
+      - call: readSessionTranscriptSummary
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - ref: session
+        saveAs: transcript
+      - assert:
+          expr: transcript.finalText.includes("PERSONAL-NO-FAKE-PROGRESS-OK")
+          message: The Gateway transcript must contain the final response
+      - assert:
+          expr: "!transcript.hasDirectReplySelfMessage"
+          message: The final reply must not be duplicated by a self-send
+      - call: fs.readFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, "personal-progress-proof.txt")
+          - utf8
+        saveAs: artifact
+      - assert:
+          expr: artifact.includes('not sent; not published; not uploaded; not merged') && transcript.finalText.includes('not sent, not published, not uploaded, not merged')
+          message: Local progress must not be presented as an external effect
+      - set: effect
+        value:
+          ref: artifact
+  - name: Retain observed final state and raw local events
+    actions:
+      - set: proof
+        value:
+          expr: ({schema:'QaScenarioFinalState/v1',driven_by:'agent',actor:'codex-tf0578-qa-pack',scenarioId:scenario.id,sessionKey:session,runId:turn.started.runId,waitStatus:turn.waited.status,finalText:transcript.finalText,effect,workspaceDir:env.gateway.workspaceDir,tempRoot:env.gateway.tempRoot})
+      - call: fetchJson
+        args:
+          - expr: env.mock.baseUrl.replace(/\/v1\/?$/, '') + '/debug/requests'
+        saveAs: providerEvents
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.events.json')
+          - expr: JSON.stringify({driven_by:'agent',actor:'codex-tf0578-qa-pack',bus:state.getSnapshot(),provider:providerEvents},null,2) + '\n'
+          - utf8
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.proof.json')
+          - expr: JSON.stringify(proof,null,2) + '\n'
+          - utf8
+    detailsExpr: JSON.stringify(proof)
+```

+# A local reminder reaches its QA conversation
+
+Agent-driven source-host fixture. Scripted replies prove control flow and tool semantics; they do not measure model quality.
+
+```yaml qa-scenario
+id: personal-reminder-roundtrip
+title: A local reminder reaches its QA conversation
+surface: cron + qa-channel
+objective: Create and force one disposable reminder, verify its real Gateway run
+  and channel delivery, then remove it.
+risk: medium
+successCriteria:
+  - The real Gateway final response matches deterministic effect readback.
+  - A failure, denial or missing artifact cannot be counted as success.
+execution:
+  kind: flow
+```
+
+```yaml qa-flow
+steps:
+  - name: Create a disposable reminder through Gateway
+    actions:
+      - call: createSession
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - expr: scenario.id
+        saveAs: session
+      - set: afterTs
+        value:
+          expr: Date.now()
+      - call: env.gateway.call
+        args:
+          - cron.add
+          - agentId: qa
+            name: TF-0578 local reminder
+            enabled: true
+            deleteAfterRun: false
+            schedule:
+              kind: at
+              at:
+                expr: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000).toISOString()
+            sessionTarget: isolated
+            payload:
+              kind: agentTurn
+              message: "Personal reminder marker. Reply exactly: PERSONAL-REMINDER-OK"
+            delivery:
+              mode: announce
+              channel: qa-channel
+              to: dm:qa-operator
+        saveAs: job
+      - assert:
+          expr: typeof job.id === 'string' && job.id.length > 0
+          message: Gateway must assign a real reminder ID
+  - name: Execute the reminder and verify delivery
+    actions:
+      - call: env.gateway.call
+        args:
+          - cron.run
+          - id:
+              ref: job.id
+            mode: force
+          - timeoutMs: 60000
+        saveAs: trigger
+      - call: waitForCronRunCompletion
+        args:
+          - callGateway:
+              lambda:
+                params:
+                  - method
+                  - params
+                  - options
+                expr: env.gateway.call(method, params, options)
+                async: true
+            jobId:
+              ref: job.id
+            afterTs:
+              ref: afterTs
+            timeoutMs: 60000
+            intervalMs: 200
+        saveAs: cronRun
+      - assert:
+          expr: cronRun.status === 'ok' && cronRun.deliveryStatus === 'delivered'
+          message: The reminder must finish and be delivered
+      - call: waitForOutboundMessage
+        args:
+          - ref: state
+          - lambda:
+              params:
+                - message
+              expr: message.text.includes('PERSONAL-REMINDER-OK')
+          - 60000
+        saveAs: reminderReply
+      - call: runAgentPrompt
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - sessionKey:
+              ref: session
+            message: "Local reminder verification marker. Reply exactly: PERSONAL-REMINDER-VERIFIED"
+            timeoutMs: 60000
+        saveAs: turn
+      - call: waitForOutboundMessage
+        args:
+          - ref: state
+          - lambda:
+              params:
+                - message
+              expr: message.text.includes("PERSONAL-REMINDER-VERIFIED")
+          - 60000
+        saveAs: reply
+      - call: readSessionTranscriptSummary
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - ref: session
+        saveAs: transcript
+      - assert:
+          expr: transcript.finalText.includes("PERSONAL-REMINDER-VERIFIED")
+          message: The Gateway transcript must contain the final response
+      - assert:
+          expr: "!transcript.hasDirectReplySelfMessage"
+          message: The final reply must not be duplicated by a self-send
+      - call: env.gateway.call
+        args:
+          - cron.remove
+          - id:
+              ref: job.id
+        saveAs: removed
+      - set: effect
+        value:
+          expr: ({jobId:job.id,cronRun,reminderReply:reminderReply.text,removed})
+  - name: Retain observed final state and raw local events
+    actions:
+      - set: proof
+        value:
+          expr: ({schema:'QaScenarioFinalState/v1',driven_by:'agent',actor:'codex-tf0578-qa-pack',scenarioId:scenario.id,sessionKey:session,runId:turn.started.runId,waitStatus:turn.waited.status,finalText:transcript.finalText,effect,workspaceDir:env.gateway.workspaceDir,tempRoot:env.gateway.tempRoot})
+      - call: fetchJson
+        args:
+          - expr: env.mock.baseUrl.replace(/\/v1\/?$/, '') + '/debug/requests'
+        saveAs: providerEvents
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.events.json')
+          - expr: JSON.stringify({driven_by:'agent',actor:'codex-tf0578-qa-pack',bus:state.getSnapshot(),provider:providerEvents},null,2) + '\n'
+          - utf8
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.proof.json')
+          - expr: JSON.stringify(proof,null,2) + '\n'
+          - utf8
+    detailsExpr: JSON.stringify(proof)
+```

+          - ref: state
+          - lambda:
+              params:

+              expr: 'message.text.includes("Done: local evidence captured in personal-task-status.txt")'
+          - 60000

+          - utf8
+        saveAs: artifact

+          message: Local completion must not imply publication
+      - set: effect
+        value:
+          ref: artifact
+  - name: Retain observed final state and raw local events
+    actions:
+      - set: proof
+        value:
+          expr: ({schema:'QaScenarioFinalState/v1',driven_by:'agent',actor:'codex-tf0578-qa-pack',scenarioId:scenario.id,sessionKey:session,runId:turn.started.runId,waitStatus:turn.waited.status,finalText:transcript.finalText,effect,workspaceDir:env.gateway.workspaceDir,tempRoot:env.gateway.tempRoot})

+        saveAs: providerEvents
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.events.json')

+          - utf8
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.proof.json')
+          - expr: JSON.stringify(proof,null,2) + '\n'
+          - utf8
+    detailsExpr: JSON.stringify(proof)
+```

+# Tool followthrough obeys the local workspace contract
+
+Agent-driven source-host fixture. Scripted replies prove control flow and tool semantics; they do not measure model quality.
+
+```yaml qa-scenario
+id: personal-tool-safety-followthrough
+title: Tool followthrough obeys the local workspace contract
+surface: read/write tools
+objective: Read the contract and inputs before creating the requested artifact;
+  preserve an agent-owned file outside the workspace.
+risk: medium
+successCriteria:
+  - The real Gateway final response matches deterministic effect readback.
+  - A failure, denial or missing artifact cannot be counted as success.
+execution:
+  kind: flow
+```
+
+```yaml qa-flow
+steps:
+  - name: Follow the contract and verify the actual file effect
+    actions:
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, "AGENT.md")
+          - |
+            # Repo contract
+            Mission: prove you followed the repo contract.
+            Create only the requested local artifact. Keep the outside-workspace canary unchanged.
+          - utf8
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, "SOUL.md")
+          - |
+            # Execution style
+            Read the input before writing the summary.
+          - utf8
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, "FOLLOWTHROUGH_INPUT.md")
+          - |
+            # Followthrough input
+            Evidence path: AGENT.md -> SOUL.md -> FOLLOWTHROUGH_INPUT.md
+            The local task is complete only when repo-contract-summary.txt exists.
+          - utf8
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.tempRoot, 'outside-workspace-canary.txt')
+          - UNCHANGED
+          - utf8
+      - call: createSession
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - expr: scenario.id
+        saveAs: session
+      - call: runAgentPrompt
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - sessionKey:
+              ref: session
+            message: Repo contract followthrough check. Follow the workspace contract and create its proof artifact.
+            timeoutMs: 60000
+        saveAs: turn
+      - call: waitForOutboundMessage
+        args:
+          - ref: state
+          - lambda:
+              params:
+                - message
+              expr: 'message.text.includes("Status: complete")'
+          - 60000
+        saveAs: reply
+      - call: readSessionTranscriptSummary
+        args:
+          - ref: env
+          - ref: session
+        saveAs: transcript
+      - assert:
+          expr: 'transcript.finalText.includes("Status: complete")'
+          message: The Gateway transcript must contain the final response
+      - assert:
+          expr: "!transcript.hasDirectReplySelfMessage"
+          message: The final reply must not be duplicated by a self-send
+      - call: fs.readFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, "repo-contract-summary.txt")
+          - utf8
+        saveAs: artifact
+      - assert:
+          expr: artifact.includes('AGENT.md -> SOUL.md -> FOLLOWTHROUGH_INPUT.md')
+          message: The local artifact must record its inputs
+      - call: fs.readFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.tempRoot, 'outside-workspace-canary.txt')
+          - utf8
+        saveAs: canary
+      - assert:
+          expr: canary === 'UNCHANGED'
+          message: The outside-workspace canary must stay unchanged
+      - set: effect
+        value:
+          expr: ({artifact,outsideWorkspaceCanary:canary})
+  - name: Retain observed final state and raw local events
+    actions:
+      - set: proof
+        value:
+          expr: ({schema:'QaScenarioFinalState/v1',driven_by:'agent',actor:'codex-tf0578-qa-pack',scenarioId:scenario.id,sessionKey:session,runId:turn.started.runId,waitStatus:turn.waited.status,finalText:transcript.finalText,effect,workspaceDir:env.gateway.workspaceDir,tempRoot:env.gateway.tempRoot})
+      - call: fetchJson
+        args:
+          - expr: env.mock.baseUrl.replace(/\/v1\/?$/, '') + '/debug/requests'
+        saveAs: providerEvents
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.events.json')
+          - expr: JSON.stringify({driven_by:'agent',actor:'codex-tf0578-qa-pack',bus:state.getSnapshot(),provider:providerEvents},null,2) + '\n'
+          - utf8
+      - call: fs.writeFile
+        args:
+          - expr: path.join(env.gateway.workspaceDir, scenario.id + '.proof.json')
+          - expr: JSON.stringify(proof,null,2) + '\n'
+          - utf8
+    detailsExpr: JSON.stringify(proof)
+```

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
+import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
+import fs from "node:fs/promises";
+import os from "node:os";
+import path from "node:path";
+import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
+import { parseArgs } from "node:util";
+
+const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
+const runtimeRoot = path.join(root, "openclaw_runtime");
+const { values } = parseArgs({
+  options: {
+    preflight: { type: "boolean" },
+    "negative-controls": { type: "boolean" },
+    "output-dir": { type: "string" },
+    scenario: { type: "string", multiple: true },
+  },
+});
+
+function commandResult(command, args, cwd = root) {
+  const result = spawnSync(command, args, {
+    cwd,
+    env: process.env,
+    encoding: "utf8",
+    windowsHide: true,
+    maxBuffer: 16 * 1024 * 1024,
+  });
+  if (result.error) throw result.error;
+  return result;
+}
+
+async function readBuildBinding(candidate) {
+  const stamps = {};
+  for (const name of [".buildstamp", ".runtime-postbuildstamp"]) {
+    const stamp = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(runtimeRoot, "dist", name), "utf8"));
+    assert.equal(
+      stamp.head,
+      candidate.commit,
+      `Stale QA build ${name}; rebuild private QA for this candidate`,
+    );
+    stamps[name] = stamp;
+  }
+  const files = [];
+  async function walk(directory) {
+    for (const entry of await fs.readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
+      const absolute = path.join(directory, entry.name);
+      if (entry.isDirectory()) await walk(absolute);
+      else if (entry.isFile()) {
+        const bytes = await fs.readFile(absolute);
+        files.push({
+          path: path.relative(runtimeRoot, absolute).replaceAll("\\", "/"),
+          bytes: bytes.length,
+          sha256: createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex"),
+        });
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  await walk(path.join(runtimeRoot, "dist"));
+  await walk(path.join(runtimeRoot, "dist-runtime"));
+  files.sort((left, right) => left.path.localeCompare(right.path));
+  return {
+    stamps,
+    files,
+    digest: createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify(files)).digest("hex"),
+  };
+}
+
+async function runNegativeControls() {
+  const git = (args) => {
+    const result = commandResult("git", args);
+    assert.equal(result.status, 0, result.stderr);
+    return result.stdout.trim();
+  };
+  assert.equal(
+    git(["status", "--porcelain"]),
+    "",
+    "Negative controls require a clean source candidate",
+  );
+  const candidate = {
+    commit: git(["rev-parse", "HEAD"]),
+    tree: git(["rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"]),
+    dirty: false,
+  };
+  const build = await readBuildBinding(candidate);
+  const runRoot = await fs.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "clawx-qa-negative-"));
+  const projection = path.join(runRoot, "source");
+  await fs.mkdir(projection);
+  const archivePath = path.join(runRoot, "source.tar");
+  git(["archive", "--format=tar", `--output=${archivePath}`, "HEAD"]);
+  const extracted = commandResult("tar", ["-xf", archivePath, "-C", projection]);
+  assert.equal(extracted.status, 0, extracted.stderr);
+  const packagePaths = git(["ls-files", "*package.json"]).split("\n");
+  for (const packagePath of packagePaths) {
+    const dependencyPath = path.join(path.dirname(packagePath), "node_modules");
+    if (
+      await fs.stat(path.join(root, dependencyPath)).then(
+        () => true,
+        () => false,
+      )
+    ) {
+      await fs.symlink(
+        path.join(root, dependencyPath),
+        path.join(projection, dependencyPath),
+        process.platform === "win32" ? "junction" : "dir",
+      );
+    }
+  }
+  const projectedRuntime = path.join(projection, "openclaw_runtime");
+  for (const directory of ["dist", "dist-runtime"]) {
+    await fs.cp(path.join(runtimeRoot, directory), path.join(projectedRuntime, directory), {
+      recursive: true,
+    });
+  }
+  for (const file of build.files) {
+    const copied = await fs.readFile(path.join(projectedRuntime, file.path));
+    assert.equal(
+      createHash("sha256").update(copied).digest("hex"),
+      file.sha256,
+      `Copied build drift: ${file.path}`,
+    );
+  }
+  const qa = await import(
+    pathToFileURL(path.join(runtimeRoot, "dist/extensions/qa-lab/api.js")).href
+  );
+  const fixturesDir = path.join(projectedRuntime, "qa/scenarios");
+  const originals = new Map(
+    await Promise.all(
+      qa.QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS.map(async (id) => [
+        id,
+        await fs.readFile(path.join(fixturesDir, `${id}.md`)),
+      ]),
+    ),
+  );
+  const controls = [];
+  const run = async (id, args = []) => {
+    const outputDir = `.artifacts/qa-e2e/${id}`;
+    const invocation = [
+      path.join(projection, "scripts/qa-lab-personal-agent-acceptance.mjs"),
+      "--output-dir",
+      outputDir,
+      ...args,
+    ];
+    const result = commandResult(process.execPath, invocation, projection);
+    await fs.writeFile(path.join(runRoot, `${id}.log`), result.stdout + result.stderr);
+    assert.equal(result.status, 1, `${id} must exit nonzero`);
+    return {
+      id,
+      command: [process.execPath, ...invocation],
+      exitCode: result.status,
+      outputDir: path.join(projectedRuntime, outputDir),
+      logPath: path.join(runRoot, `${id}.log`),
+      stderr: result.stderr,
+    };
+  };
+  const restore = async () => {
+    for (const [id, bytes] of originals)
+      await fs.writeFile(path.join(fixturesDir, `${id}.md`), bytes);
+  };
+  try {
+    const missingId = qa.QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS[0];
+    await fs.unlink(path.join(fixturesDir, `${missingId}.md`));
+    const missing = await run("missing-fixture");
+    assert.ok(missing.stderr.includes(`unknown QA scenario id(s): ${missingId}`));
+    controls.push(missing);
+    await restore();
+    for (const id of originals.keys()) await fs.unlink(path.join(fixturesDir, `${id}.md`));
+    const emptyApiUrl = pathToFileURL(
+      path.join(projectedRuntime, "dist/extensions/qa-lab/api.js"),
+    ).href;
+    const emptyCount = commandResult(
+      process.execPath,
+      [
+        "--input-type=module",
+        "-e",
+        `const qa = await import(${JSON.stringify(emptyApiUrl)}); console.log(qa.readQaBootstrapScenarioCatalog().scenarios.length);`,
+      ],
+      projection,
+    );
+    assert.equal(emptyCount.status, 0, emptyCount.stderr);
+    assert.equal(emptyCount.stdout.trim(), "0", "The actual catalog must be empty");
+    const empty = await run("empty-catalog");
+    assert.ok(empty.stderr.includes("unknown QA scenario id(s)"));
+    controls.push({ ...empty, actualCatalogCount: 0 });
+    await restore();
+    const falseId = "personal-no-fake-progress";
+    const falsePath = path.join(fixturesDir, `${falseId}.md`);
+    const falseFixture = originals
+      .get(falseId)
+      .toString("utf8")
+      .replace(
+        /      - set: effect\r?\n/,
+        '      - assert:\n          expr: "false"\n          message: "TF-0578 deliberate false final-state oracle"\n      - set: effect\n',
+      );
+    assert.ok(falseFixture.includes("deliberate false final-state oracle"));
+    await fs.writeFile(falsePath, falseFixture);
+    const failed = await run("false-final-state", [
+      "--scenario",
+      falseId,
+      "--scenario",
+      "personal-memory-preference-recall",
+    ]);
+    const summary = JSON.parse(
+      await fs.readFile(path.join(failed.outputDir, "qa-suite-summary.json"), "utf8"),
+    );
+    assert.deepEqual(summary.counts, { total: 2, passed: 1, failed: 1 });
+    assert.deepEqual(
+      summary.scenarios.map((scenario) => scenario.status),
+      ["fail", "pass"],
+    );
+    assert.ok(summary.scenarios[0].details.includes("deliberate false final-state oracle"));
+    const continued = JSON.parse(summary.scenarios[1].steps.at(-1).details);
+    assert.equal(continued.waitStatus, "ok");
+    const actualArtifact = await fs.readFile(
+      path.join(continued.workspaceDir, "personal-progress-proof.txt"),
+      "utf8",
+    );
+    assert.ok(actualArtifact.includes("not sent; not published; not uploaded; not merged"));
+    controls.push({
+      ...failed,
+      counts: summary.counts,
+      continued,
+      falseClaimArtifactObserved: true,
+    });
+  } finally {
+    await restore();
+  }
+  assert.equal(git(["status", "--porcelain"]), "", "Original source must remain unchanged");
+  const receipt = {
+    driven_by: "agent",
+    actor: "codex-tf0578-qa-pack",
+    candidate,
+    build,
+    reusedDependencies: true,
+    runRoot,
+    projection,
+    controls,
+  };
+  const receiptPath = path.join(runRoot, "negative-controls.json");
+  await fs.writeFile(receiptPath, JSON.stringify(receipt, null, 2) + "\n");
+  console.log(
+    JSON.stringify(
+      { receiptPath, controls: controls.map(({ id, exitCode }) => ({ id, exitCode })) },
+      null,
+      2,
+    ),
+  );
+}
+
+try {
+  if (values["negative-controls"]) {
+    await runNegativeControls();
+    process.exit(0);
+  }
+  const qa = await import(
+    pathToFileURL(path.join(runtimeRoot, "dist/extensions/qa-lab/api.js")).href
+  );
+  const requestedIds = values.scenario?.length
+    ? values.scenario
+    : [...qa.QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS];
+  const scenarioIds = values.preflight ? requestedIds.slice(0, 1) : requestedIds;
+  const result = await qa.runQaSuite({
+    repoRoot: runtimeRoot,
+    outputDir: values["output-dir"],
+    providerMode: "mock-openai",
+    scenarioIds,
+    concurrency: 1,
+    controlUiEnabled: false,
+    startLab: qa.startQaLabServer,
+  });
+  const summary = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(result.summaryPath, "utf8"));
+  assert.deepEqual(
+    summary.run.scenarioIds,
+    scenarioIds,
+    "Selected scenarios must match the request",
+  );
+  assert.equal(summary.counts.total, scenarioIds.length, "Every requested scenario must execute");
+  assert.equal(
+    summary.scenarios.length,
+    scenarioIds.length,
+    "Empty or partial execution is a failure",
+  );
+  assert.equal(summary.counts.failed, 0, "Failed final-state assertions must fail acceptance");
+  assert.equal(summary.counts.passed, scenarioIds.length);
+  for (const scenario of summary.scenarios) {
+    assert.equal(scenario.status, "pass", `${scenario.name} must pass without skips`);
+    assert.ok(scenario.steps.length > 0, "A scenario requires observed steps");
+    assert.ok(
+      scenario.steps.every((step) => step.status === "pass"),
+      "Unexpected skipped steps fail acceptance",
+    );
+  }
+  console.log(
+    JSON.stringify(
+      {
+        driven_by: "agent",
+        actor: "codex-tf0578-qa-pack",
+        providerMode: "mock-openai",
+        evidenceLevel: "source-host",
+        summaryPath: result.summaryPath,
+        scenarioIds,
+        counts: summary.counts,
+      },
+      null,
+      2,
+    ),
+  );
+} catch (error) {
+  console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
+  process.exitCode = 1;
+}
