+#!/usr/bin/env node
+
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
+import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
+import fs from "node:fs/promises";
+import os from "node:os";
+import path from "node:path";
+import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
+import { parseArgs } from "node:util";
+
+const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
+const runtimeRoot = path.join(root, "openclaw_runtime");
+const { values } = parseArgs({
+  options: {
+    preflight: { type: "boolean" },
+    "negative-controls": { type: "boolean" },
+    "output-dir": { type: "string" },
+    scenario: { type: "string", multiple: true },
+  },
+});
+
+function commandResult(command, args, cwd = root) {
+  const result = spawnSync(command, args, {
+    cwd,
+    env: process.env,
+    encoding: "utf8",
+    windowsHide: true,
+    maxBuffer: 16 * 1024 * 1024,
+  });
+  if (result.error) throw result.error;
+  return result;
+}
+
+async function readBuildBinding(candidate) {
+  const stamps = {};
+  for (const name of [".buildstamp", ".runtime-postbuildstamp"]) {
+    const stamp = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.join(runtimeRoot, "dist", name), "utf8"));
+    assert.equal(
+      stamp.head,
+      candidate.commit,
+      `Stale QA build ${name}; rebuild private QA for this candidate`,
+    );
+    stamps[name] = stamp;
+  }
+  const files = [];
+  async function walk(directory) {
+    for (const entry of await fs.readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
+      const absolute = path.join(directory, entry.name);
+      if (entry.isDirectory()) await walk(absolute);
+      else if (entry.isFile()) {
+        const bytes = await fs.readFile(absolute);
+        files.push({
+          path: path.relative(runtimeRoot, absolute).replaceAll("\\", "/"),
+          bytes: bytes.length,
+          sha256: createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex"),
+        });
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  await walk(path.join(runtimeRoot, "dist"));
+  await walk(path.join(runtimeRoot, "dist-runtime"));
+  files.sort((left, right) => left.path.localeCompare(right.path));
+  return {
+    stamps,
+    files,
+    digest: createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify(files)).digest("hex"),
+  };
+}
+
+async function runNegativeControls() {
+  const git = (args) => {
+    const result = commandResult("git", args);
+    assert.equal(result.status, 0, result.stderr);
+    return result.stdout.trim();
+  };
+  assert.equal(
+    git(["status", "--porcelain"]),
+    "",
+    "Negative controls require a clean source candidate",
+  );
+  const candidate = {
+    commit: git(["rev-parse", "HEAD"]),
+    tree: git(["rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"]),
+    dirty: false,
+  };
+  const build = await readBuildBinding(candidate);
+  const runRoot = await fs.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "clawx-qa-negative-"));
+  const projection = path.join(runRoot, "source");
+  await fs.mkdir(projection);
+  const archivePath = path.join(runRoot, "source.tar");
+  git(["archive", "--format=tar", `--output=${archivePath}`, "HEAD"]);
+  const extracted = commandResult("tar", ["-xf", archivePath, "-C", projection]);
+  assert.equal(extracted.status, 0, extracted.stderr);
+  const packagePaths = git(["ls-files", "*package.json"]).split("\n");
+  for (const packagePath of packagePaths) {
+    const dependencyPath = path.join(path.dirname(packagePath), "node_modules");
+    if (
+      await fs.stat(path.join(root, dependencyPath)).then(
+        () => true,
+        () => false,
+      )
+    ) {
+      await fs.symlink(
+        path.join(root, dependencyPath),
+        path.join(projection, dependencyPath),
+        process.platform === "win32" ? "junction" : "dir",
+      );
+    }
+  }
+  const projectedRuntime = path.join(projection, "openclaw_runtime");
+  for (const directory of ["dist", "dist-runtime"]) {
+    await fs.cp(path.join(runtimeRoot, directory), path.join(projectedRuntime, directory), {
+      recursive: true,
+    });
+  }
+  for (const file of build.files) {
+    const copied = await fs.readFile(path.join(projectedRuntime, file.path));
+    assert.equal(
+      createHash("sha256").update(copied).digest("hex"),
+      file.sha256,
+      `Copied build drift: ${file.path}`,
+    );
+  }
+  const qa = await import(
+    pathToFileURL(path.join(runtimeRoot, "dist/extensions/qa-lab/api.js")).href
+  );
+  const fixturesDir = path.join(projectedRuntime, "qa/scenarios");
+  const originals = new Map(
+    await Promise.all(
+      qa.QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS.map(async (id) => [
+        id,
+        await fs.readFile(path.join(fixturesDir, `${id}.md`)),
+      ]),
+    ),
+  );
+  const controls = [];
+  const run = async (id, args = []) => {
+    const outputDir = `.artifacts/qa-e2e/${id}`;
+    const invocation = [
+      path.join(projection, "scripts/qa-lab-personal-agent-acceptance.mjs"),
+      "--output-dir",
+      outputDir,
+      ...args,
+    ];
+    const result = commandResult(process.execPath, invocation, projection);
+    await fs.writeFile(path.join(runRoot, `${id}.log`), result.stdout + result.stderr);
+    assert.equal(result.status, 1, `${id} must exit nonzero`);
+    return {
+      id,
+      command: [process.execPath, ...invocation],
+      exitCode: result.status,
+      outputDir: path.join(projectedRuntime, outputDir),
+      logPath: path.join(runRoot, `${id}.log`),
+      stderr: result.stderr,
+    };
+  };
+  const restore = async () => {
+    for (const [id, bytes] of originals)
+      await fs.writeFile(path.join(fixturesDir, `${id}.md`), bytes);
+  };
+  try {
+    const missingId = qa.QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS[0];
+    await fs.unlink(path.join(fixturesDir, `${missingId}.md`));
+    const missing = await run("missing-fixture");
+    assert.ok(missing.stderr.includes(`unknown QA scenario id(s): ${missingId}`));
+    controls.push(missing);
+    await restore();
+    for (const id of originals.keys()) await fs.unlink(path.join(fixturesDir, `${id}.md`));
+    const emptyApiUrl = pathToFileURL(
+      path.join(projectedRuntime, "dist/extensions/qa-lab/api.js"),
+    ).href;
+    const emptyCount = commandResult(
+      process.execPath,
+      [
+        "--input-type=module",
+        "-e",
+        `const qa = await import(${JSON.stringify(emptyApiUrl)}); console.log(qa.readQaBootstrapScenarioCatalog().scenarios.length);`,
+      ],
+      projection,
+    );
+    assert.equal(emptyCount.status, 0, emptyCount.stderr);
+    assert.equal(emptyCount.stdout.trim(), "0", "The actual catalog must be empty");
+    const empty = await run("empty-catalog");
+    assert.ok(empty.stderr.includes("unknown QA scenario id(s)"));
+    controls.push({ ...empty, actualCatalogCount: 0 });
+    await restore();
+    const falseId = "personal-no-fake-progress";
+    const falsePath = path.join(fixturesDir, `${falseId}.md`);
+    const falseFixture = originals
+      .get(falseId)
+      .toString("utf8")
+      .replace(
+        /      - set: effect\r?\n/,
+        '      - assert:\n          expr: "false"\n          message: "TF-0578 deliberate false final-state oracle"\n      - set: effect\n',
+      );
+    assert.ok(falseFixture.includes("deliberate false final-state oracle"));
+    await fs.writeFile(falsePath, falseFixture);
+    const failed = await run("false-final-state", [
+      "--scenario",
+      falseId,
+      "--scenario",
+      "personal-memory-preference-recall",
+    ]);
+    const summary = JSON.parse(
+      await fs.readFile(path.join(failed.outputDir, "qa-suite-summary.json"), "utf8"),
+    );
+    assert.deepEqual(summary.counts, { total: 2, passed: 1, failed: 1 });
+    assert.deepEqual(
+      summary.scenarios.map((scenario) => scenario.status),
+      ["fail", "pass"],
+    );
+    assert.ok(summary.scenarios[0].details.includes("deliberate false final-state oracle"));
+    const continued = JSON.parse(summary.scenarios[1].steps.at(-1).details);
+    assert.equal(continued.waitStatus, "ok");
+    const actualArtifact = await fs.readFile(
+      path.join(continued.workspaceDir, "personal-progress-proof.txt"),
+      "utf8",
+    );
+    assert.ok(actualArtifact.includes("not sent; not published; not uploaded; not merged"));
+    controls.push({
+      ...failed,
+      counts: summary.counts,
+      continued,
+      falseClaimArtifactObserved: true,
+    });
+  } finally {
+    await restore();
+  }
+  assert.equal(git(["status", "--porcelain"]), "", "Original source must remain unchanged");
+  const receipt = {
+    driven_by: "agent",
+    actor: "codex-tf0578-qa-pack",
+    candidate,
+    build,
+    reusedDependencies: true,
+    runRoot,
+    projection,
+    controls,
+  };
+  const receiptPath = path.join(runRoot, "negative-controls.json");
+  await fs.writeFile(receiptPath, JSON.stringify(receipt, null, 2) + "\n");
+  console.log(
+    JSON.stringify(
+      { receiptPath, controls: controls.map(({ id, exitCode }) => ({ id, exitCode })) },
+      null,
+      2,
+    ),
+  );
+}
+
+try {
+  if (values["negative-controls"]) {
+    await runNegativeControls();
+    process.exit(0);
+  }
+  const qa = await import(
+    pathToFileURL(path.join(runtimeRoot, "dist/extensions/qa-lab/api.js")).href
+  );
+  const requestedIds = values.scenario?.length
+    ? values.scenario
+    : [...qa.QA_PERSONAL_AGENT_SCENARIO_IDS];
+  const scenarioIds = values.preflight ? requestedIds.slice(0, 1) : requestedIds;
+  const result = await qa.runQaSuite({
+    repoRoot: runtimeRoot,
+    outputDir: values["output-dir"],
+    providerMode: "mock-openai",
+    scenarioIds,
+    concurrency: 1,
+    controlUiEnabled: false,
+    startLab: qa.startQaLabServer,
+  });
+  const summary = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(result.summaryPath, "utf8"));
+  assert.deepEqual(
+    summary.run.scenarioIds,
+    scenarioIds,
+    "Selected scenarios must match the request",
+  );
+  assert.equal(summary.counts.total, scenarioIds.length, "Every requested scenario must execute");
+  assert.equal(
+    summary.scenarios.length,
+    scenarioIds.length,
+    "Empty or partial execution is a failure",
+  );
+  assert.equal(summary.counts.failed, 0, "Failed final-state assertions must fail acceptance");
+  assert.equal(summary.counts.passed, scenarioIds.length);
+  for (const scenario of summary.scenarios) {
+    assert.equal(scenario.status, "pass", `${scenario.name} must pass without skips`);
+    assert.ok(scenario.steps.length > 0, "A scenario requires observed steps");
+    assert.ok(
+      scenario.steps.every((step) => step.status === "pass"),
+      "Unexpected skipped steps fail acceptance",
+    );
+  }
+  console.log(
+    JSON.stringify(
+      {
+        driven_by: "agent",
+        actor: "codex-tf0578-qa-pack",
+        providerMode: "mock-openai",
+        evidenceLevel: "source-host",
+        summaryPath: result.summaryPath,
+        scenarioIds,
+        counts: summary.counts,
+      },
+      null,
+      2,
+    ),
+  );
+} catch (error) {
+  console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
+  process.exitCode = 1;
+}

Need inspect current files around relevant code. Use sed via PowerShell? Get-Content. We can use git show HEAD: files. Need understand API and path policy. Potential bugs:
- readBuildBinding stamps verifies commit only, not tree/dirty source. But negative controls requires clean status and candidate commit. build stamps likely include tree maybe? Need inspect buildstamp format and build scripts.
- commandResult uses process.env, inherits C temp maybe policy but not correctness.
- negative controls git archive output via argument `--output=...`; fine.
- tar availability? Windows tar.
- symlink node_modules into projection: `git ls-files "*package.json"` includes nested package.json where node_modules doesn't exist in source? It computes path dirname(packagePath) and if root node_modules exists, creates nested path symlink to root node_modules, e.g. openclaw_runtime/node_modules -> root node_modules, maybe root package dependencies via workspace package resolution? Could be intended. But if destination parent directory doesn't exist, fs.symlink fails. openclaw_runtime likely has node_modules? Check. Also `git ls-files "*package.json"` maybe includes packages in node_modules? tracked only. packagePath root package.json gives root/node_modules. openclaw_runtime/package.json parent root; then path.join(root, dependencyPath) => root/node_modules. For nested package in e.g. `packages/foo/package.json`, root/packages/foo/node_modules likely absent -> no symlink. No parent creation. Could be okay.

More important: archive excludes untracked source? negative clean ensures no untracked. Good.
- It imports current dist qa API before mutations. readBuildBinding walks all files, including `.buildstamp`. Candidate stamps check `stamp.head === candidate.commit` only. A build from same commit but different source content? clean candidate means same commit, but could build have stale generated files despite stamp commit? Buildstamp likely includes tree hash maybe. They don't check candidate tree or stamps tree. User says fixed candidate stamps/file hashes. The negative control uses file hashes only to ensure copied build files match current build; but current build could be stale against candidate source if stamps only head. However maybe stamps include tree and should compare. Need inspect .buildstamp and runtime-postbuildstamp. Read-only allowed.

   43:     );
   44:     stamps[name] = stamp;
   45:   }
   46:   const files = [];
   47:   async function walk(directory) {
   48:     for (const entry of await fs.readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
   49:       const absolute = path.join(directory, entry.name);
   50:       if (entry.isDirectory()) await walk(absolute);
   51:       else if (entry.isFile()) {
   52:         const bytes = await fs.readFile(absolute);
   53:         files.push({
   54:           path: path.relative(runtimeRoot, absolute).replaceAll("\\", "/"),
   55:           bytes: bytes.length,
   56:           sha256: createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex"),
   57:         });
   58:       }
   59:     }
   60:   }
   61:   await walk(path.join(runtimeRoot, "dist"));
   62:   await walk(path.join(runtimeRoot, "dist-runtime"));
   63:   files.sort((left, right) => left.path.localeCompare(right.path));
   64:   return {
   65:     stamps,
   66:     files,
   67:     digest: createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify(files)).digest("hex"),
   68:   };
   69: }

   71: async function runNegativeControls() {

  491: function isRetryableRpcStartupError(error: unknown) {
  492:   const details = formatErrorMessage(error);
  493:   return (
  494:     details.includes("gateway timeout after") ||
  495:     details.includes("handshake timeout") ||
  496:     details.includes("gateway token mismatch") ||
  497:     details.includes("token mismatch") ||
  498:     details.includes("gateway closed (1000") ||
  499:     details.includes("gateway closed (1006") ||
  500:     details.includes("gateway closed (1012)")
  501:   );
  502: }

  504: export function resolveQaControlUiRoot(params: { repoRoot: string; controlUiEnabled?: boolean }) {

  511: }

  171: async function waitForQaLabReady(baseUrl: string, timeoutMs = 10_000) {
  172:   const startedAt = Date.now();
  173:   while (Date.now() - startedAt < timeoutMs) {
  174:     try {
  175:       const { response, release } = await fetchWithSsrFGuard({
  176:         url: `${baseUrl}/readyz`,
  177:         policy: { allowPrivateNetwork: true },
  178:         auditContext: "qa-lab-suite-wait-for-lab-ready",
  179:       });
  180:       try {
  181:         if (response.ok) {
  182:           return;
  183:         }
  184:       } finally {
  185:         await release();
  186:       }
  187:     } catch {
  188:       // retry
  189:     }
  190:     await sleep(100);
  191:   }
  192:   throw new Error(`timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms waiting for qa-lab ready`);
  193: }
  194:
  195: async function waitForQaLabReadyOrStopOwned(params: {
  196:   lab: Pick<QaLabServerHandle, "listenUrl" | "stop">;
  197:   ownsLab: boolean;
  198:   timeoutMs?: number;
  199: }) {
  200:   try {
  201:     await waitForQaLabReady(params.lab.listenUrl, params.timeoutMs);
  202:   } catch (error) {
  203:     if (params.ownsLab) {
  204:       await params.lab.stop();
  205:     }
  206:     throw error;
  207:   }
  208: }

  210: function sanitizeQaSuiteProgressValue(value: string): string {
  211:   let normalized = "";
  212:   for (const char of value) {
  213:     const code = char.codePointAt(0);
  214:     if (code === undefined) {
  215:       continue;
  216:     }
  217:     const isControl = code <= 0x1f || (code >= 0x7f && code <= 0x9f);
  218:     normalized += isControl ? " " : char;
  219:   }
  220:   normalized = normalized.replace(/\s+/gu, " ").trim();
  221:   return normalized.length > 0 ? normalized : "<empty>";
  222: }

   96: export function readQaSuiteFailedScenarioCountFromSummary(summary: unknown): number | null {
   97:   if (!summary || typeof summary !== "object") {
   98:     return null;
   99:   }
  100:   const payload = summary as {
  101:     counts?: {
  102:       failed?: unknown;
  103:     };
  104:     scenarios?: Array<QaSuiteScenarioStatus>;
  105:   };
  106:   const countedFailures = readNonNegativeCount(payload.counts?.failed);
  107:   const scenarioFailures = Array.isArray(payload.scenarios)
  108:     ? countQaSuiteFailedScenarios(payload.scenarios)
  109:     : null;
  110:   if (countedFailures !== null && scenarioFailures !== null) {
  111:     return Math.max(countedFailures, scenarioFailures);
  112:   }
  113:   if (scenarioFailures !== null) {
  114:     return scenarioFailures;
  115:   }
  116:   return countedFailures;
  117: }
  118:
  119: export function readQaSuiteFailedOrSkippedScenarioCountFromSummary(
  120:   summary: unknown,
  121: ): number | null {
  122:   if (!summary || typeof summary !== "object") {
  123:     return null;
  124:   }
  125:   const payload = summary as {
  126:     counts?: {
  127:       total?: unknown;
  128:       failed?: unknown;
  129:       skipped?: unknown;
  130:     };
  131:     scenarios?: Array<QaSuiteScenarioStatus>;
  132:   };
  133:   // An empty run is missing execution evidence even when it reports zero failures.
  134:   if (
  135:     payload.counts?.total === 0 ||
  136:     (Array.isArray(payload.scenarios) && payload.scenarios.length === 0)
  137:   ) {
  138:     return null;
  139:   }
  140:   const countedFailures = readNonNegativeCount(payload.counts?.failed);
  141:   const countedSkipped = readNonNegativeCount(payload.counts?.skipped);
  142:   const countedBlocking =
  143:     countedFailures !== null || countedSkipped !== null
  144:       ? (countedFailures ?? 0) + (countedSkipped ?? 0)
  145:       : null;
  146:   const scenarioBlocking = Array.isArray(payload.scenarios)
  147:     ? countQaSuiteFailedOrSkippedScenarios(payload.scenarios)
  148:     : null;
  149:   if (countedBlocking !== null && scenarioBlocking !== null) {
  150:     return Math.max(countedBlocking, scenarioBlocking);
  151:   }
  152:   if (scenarioBlocking !== null) {
  153:     return scenarioBlocking;
  154:   }
  155:   return countedBlocking;
  156: }
  157:
  158: export async function readQaSuiteFailedScenarioCountFromFile(summaryPath: string): Promise<number> {
  159:   let summaryText: string;
  160:   try {
  161:     summaryText = await fs.readFile(summaryPath, "utf8");
  162:   } catch (error) {
  163:     throw new Error(
  164:       `Could not read QA summary JSON at ${summaryPath}: ${formatErrorMessage(error)}`,
  165:       { cause: error },
  166:     );
  167:   }
  168:   let payload: unknown;
  169:   try {
  170:     payload = JSON.parse(summaryText) as unknown;
  171:   } catch (error) {
  172:     throw new Error(
  173:       `Could not parse QA summary JSON at ${summaryPath}: ${formatErrorMessage(error)}`,
  174:       { cause: error },
  175:     );
  176:   }
  177:   const failedScenarioCount = readQaSuiteFailedScenarioCountFromSummary(payload);
  178:   if (failedScenarioCount !== null) {
  179:     return failedScenarioCount;
  180:   }
  181:   throw new Error(
  182:     `QA summary at ${summaryPath} did not include counts.failed or scenarios[].status.`,
  183:   );
  184: }

  241: const QA_SCENARIO_PACK_INDEX_PATH = "qa/scenarios/index.md";
  242: const QA_SCENARIO_LEGACY_OVERVIEW_PATH = "qa/scenarios.md";
  243: const QA_SCENARIO_DIR_PATH = "qa/scenarios";
  244: const QA_PACK_FENCE_RE = /```ya?ml qa-pack\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n```/i;
  245: const QA_SCENARIO_FENCE_RE = /```ya?ml qa-scenario\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n```/i;
  246: const QA_FLOW_YAML_FENCE_RE = /```ya?ml qa-flow\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n```/i;
  247: const repoPathCache = new Map<string, string | null>();
  248: let qaScenarioMarkdownPathsCache: string[] | null = null;
  249: let qaScenarioPackCache: QaScenarioPack | null = null;
  250:
  251: function walkUpDirectories(start: string): string[] {
  252:   const roots: string[] = [];
  253:   let current = path.resolve(start);
  254:   while (true) {
  255:     roots.push(current);
  256:     const parent = path.dirname(current);
  257:     if (parent === current) {
  258:       return roots;
  259:     }
  260:     current = parent;
  261:   }
  262: }
  263:
  264: function resolveRepoPath(relativePath: string, kind: "file" | "directory" = "file"): string | null {
  265:   const cacheKey = `${kind}:${relativePath}`;
  266:   if (repoPathCache.has(cacheKey)) {
  267:     return repoPathCache.get(cacheKey) ?? null;
  268:   }
  269:   for (const dir of walkUpDirectories(import.meta.dirname)) {
  270:     const candidate = path.join(dir, relativePath);
  271:     if (!fs.existsSync(candidate)) {
  272:       continue;
  273:     }
  274:     const stat = fs.statSync(candidate);
  275:     if ((kind === "file" && stat.isFile()) || (kind === "directory" && stat.isDirectory())) {
  276:       repoPathCache.set(cacheKey, candidate);
  277:       return candidate;
  278:     }
  279:   }
  280:   repoPathCache.set(cacheKey, null);
  281:   return null;
  282: }
  283:
  284: export function hasQaScenarioPack(): boolean {
  285:   return resolveRepoPath(QA_SCENARIO_PACK_INDEX_PATH, "file") !== null;
  286: }
  287:
  288: function readTextFile(relativePath: string): string {
  289:   const resolved = resolveRepoPath(relativePath, "file");
  290:   if (!resolved) {
  291:     return "";
  292:   }
  293:   return fs.readFileSync(resolved, "utf8");
  294: }
  295:
  296: function extractQaPackYaml(content: string) {
  297:   const match = content.match(QA_PACK_FENCE_RE);
  298:   if (!match?.[1]) {
  299:     throw new Error(
  300:       `qa scenario pack missing \`\`\`yaml qa-pack fence in ${QA_SCENARIO_PACK_INDEX_PATH}`,
  301:     );
  302:   }
  303:   return match[1];
  304: }
  305:
  306: function extractQaScenarioYaml(content: string, relativePath: string) {
  307:   const match = content.match(QA_SCENARIO_FENCE_RE);
  308:   if (!match?.[1]) {
  309:     throw new Error(`qa scenario file missing \`\`\`yaml qa-scenario fence in ${relativePath}`);
  310:   }
  311:   return match[1];
  312: }

  314: function extractQaScenarioFlow(content: string, relativePath: string) {
  315:   const match = content.match(QA_FLOW_YAML_FENCE_RE);
  316:   if (!match?.[1]) {
  317:     throw new Error(`qa scenario file missing \`\`\`yaml qa-flow fence in ${relativePath}`);
  318:   }
  319:   return parseQaYamlWithContext(qaFlowSchema, YAML.parse(match[1]) as unknown, relativePath);
  320: }
  321:
  322: function formatZodIssuePath(pathLocal: PropertyKey[]) {
  323:   return pathLocal.length ? pathLocal.map(String).join(".") : "<root>";
  324: }
  325:
  326: function parseQaYamlWithContext<T>(schema: z.ZodType<T>, value: unknown, label: string): T {
  327:   const parsed = schema.safeParse(value);
  328:   if (parsed.success) {
  329:     return parsed.data;
  330:   }
  331:   const issues = parsed.error.issues
  332:     .map((issue) => `${formatZodIssuePath(issue.path)}: ${issue.message}`)
  333:     .join("; ");
  334:   throw new Error(`${label}: ${issues}`);
  335: }

  337: export function readQaScenarioPackMarkdown(): string {

  340:     chunks.push(readTextFile(relativePath).trim());
  341:   }
  342:   return chunks.filter(Boolean).join("\n\n");
  343: }

  361:       scenarios: [],

Security: fixture uses `qaImport` dynamic import and eval flows; existing intended. Patch removes allowlist in scenario-flow-runner.ts, changing `qaImport` from restricted known fixture modules to arbitrary `import(specifier)`. This is potentially significant security regression! The original code had explicit `qaFlowImportLoaders` only allowing `./auth-profile.fixture.js` and `./codex-plugin.fixture.js`, else falls through to `import(specifier)` actually wait original:
```
qaImport: (specifier) => {
 const loader = qaFlowImportLoaders[specifier];
 return loader ? loader() : import(specifier);
}
```
So it already allowed arbitrary import fallback. Patch only removes special loaders. No regression. But bundled build concerns.

The QA fixtures call `qaImport` for `node:url` and dist path; direct dynamic import is intended.

Potential issue: user specifically says review patch, likely hidden expected findings? Could be no findings. But let's inspect tricky lines.

1. `readBuildBinding` only runs in negative controls, not normal pack. Thus normal full pack acceptance could use stale build despite user says build binding fixed with candidate stamps/file hashes. Is this a defect? The script's normal path imports dist API directly. It does not call `readBuildBinding`, so a user can run full pack with stale dist and it will generate an acceptance summary from stale code. README says build command, spec says retained candidate binding. But negative controls read stamps; candidate pack should be clean before landing. The user explicitly says "readBuildBinding and isolated negative controls". Maybe expected issue is that readBuildBinding is only in negative controls, meaning full run lacks provenance. But does that make patch incorrect? The acceptance contract specifically requires "A clean committed candidate and retained a5 manifest bind actual commands ... hashes". The driver normal run does not emit manifest/hashes. However perhaps final curated pack is separate and not included. User says final clean-candidate pack required before landing, so perhaps patch intentionally doesn't include evidence yet. They ask code review, not acceptance status.

Maybe a concrete bug: `readBuildBinding` compares `.buildstamp.head` to current commit but build stamp records the commit at build time, not the source tree content. If build is generated before commit (usual), head is prior commit and fails. That's intended requiring rebuild after candidate commit.

Potential bug: `readBuildBinding` ignores symlinks and non-files in dist. If dist has symlink entries (likely?) then hashes skip them. "hashes every copied build file"; symlink is not file. Could build outputs contain symlinks? likely not.

Potential bug: `fs.cp` for dist follows symlinks by default? default `dereference: false`, copies symlinks as symlinks maybe. Then verification skips copied symlinks. Security/provenance gap: a malicious or stale symlink in dist isn't hashed, and `fs.cp` may preserve it. Need check dist entries. Use read-only Get-ChildItem maybe. But likely no symlink. Yet code contract says every copied build file, symlinks excluded. This is a potential P2. But high-signal? Maybe.

  502:   const parts = (raw ?? "").split(/\s+/u).filter(Boolean);
  503:   return parts.includes(option) ? parts.join(" ") : [...parts, option].join(" ");

  511:   env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env,

  521: function mergeQaRuntimeEnvPatches(
  522:   ...patches: Array<NodeJS.ProcessEnv | undefined>
  523: ): NodeJS.ProcessEnv | undefined {
  524:   const merged: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = {};
  525:   for (const patch of patches) {
  526:     if (!patch) {
  527:       continue;
  528:     }
  529:     Object.assign(merged, patch);
  530:   }
  531:   return Object.keys(merged).length > 0 ? merged : undefined;

  565: /**
  566:  * Pure-ish JSON builder for qa-suite-summary.json. Exported so the GPT-5.5
  567:  * parity gate (agentic-parity-report.ts, #64441) and any future parity
  568:  * runner can assert-and-trust the provider/model that produced a given
  569:  * summary instead of blindly accepting the caller's candidateLabel /
  570:  * baselineLabel. Without the `run` block, a maintainer who swaps candidate
  571:  * and baseline summary paths could silently produce a mislabeled verdict.
  572:  *
  573:  * `scenarioIds` is only recorded when the caller passed a non-empty array
  574:  * (an explicit scenario selection). A missing or empty array means "no
  575:  * filter, full lane-selected catalog", which the summary encodes as `null`
  576:  * so parity/report tooling doesn't mistake a full run for an explicit
  577:  * empty selection.
  578:  */
  579: export function buildQaSuiteSummaryJson(params: QaSuiteSummaryJsonParams): QaSuiteSummaryJson {
  580:   const primarySplit = splitModelRef(params.primaryModel);
  581:   const alternateSplit = splitModelRef(params.alternateModel);
  582:   return {
  583:     scenarios: params.scenarios,
  584:     counts: {
  585:       total: params.scenarios.length,
  586:       passed: params.scenarios.filter((scenario) => scenario.status === "pass").length,
  587:       failed: countQaSuiteFailedScenarios(params.scenarios),
  588:     },
  589:     ...(params.metrics ? { metrics: params.metrics } : {}),
  590:     run: {
  591:       startedAt: params.startedAt.toISOString(),
  592:       finishedAt: params.finishedAt.toISOString(),
  593:       providerMode: params.providerMode,
  594:       primaryModel: params.primaryModel,
  595:       primaryProvider: primarySplit?.provider ?? null,
  596:       primaryModelName: primarySplit?.model ?? null,
  597:       alternateModel: params.alternateModel,
  598:       alternateProvider: alternateSplit?.provider ?? null,
  599:       alternateModelName: alternateSplit?.model ?? null,
  600:       fastMode: params.fastMode,
  601:       concurrency: params.concurrency,
  602:       scenarioIds:
  603:         params.scenarioIds && params.scenarioIds.length > 0 ? [...params.scenarioIds] : null,
  604:       runtimePair: params.runtimePair ?? null,
  605:     },
  606:   };

  244: const QA_PACK_FENCE_RE = /```ya?ml qa-pack\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n```/i;
  245: const QA_SCENARIO_FENCE_RE = /```ya?ml qa-scenario\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n```/i;

  248: let qaScenarioMarkdownPathsCache: string[] | null = null;
  249: let qaScenarioPackCache: QaScenarioPack | null = null;
  250:
  251: function walkUpDirectories(start: string): string[] {
  252:   const roots: string[] = [];
  253:   let current = path.resolve(start);
  254:   while (true) {
  255:     roots.push(current);
  256:     const parent = path.dirname(current);
  257:     if (parent === current) {
  258:       return roots;
  259:     }
  260:     current = parent;
  261:   }
  262: }
  263:
  264: function resolveRepoPath(relativePath: string, kind: "file" | "directory" = "file"): string | null {
  265:   const cacheKey = `${kind}:${relativePath}`;
  266:   if (repoPathCache.has(cacheKey)) {
  267:     return repoPathCache.get(cacheKey) ?? null;
  268:   }
  269:   for (const dir of walkUpDirectories(import.meta.dirname)) {
  270:     const candidate = path.join(dir, relativePath);
  271:     if (!fs.existsSync(candidate)) {
  272:       continue;
  273:     }
  274:     const stat = fs.statSync(candidate);
  275:     if ((kind === "file" && stat.isFile()) || (kind === "directory" && stat.isDirectory())) {
  276:       repoPathCache.set(cacheKey, candidate);
  277:       return candidate;
  278:     }
  279:   }
  280:   repoPathCache.set(cacheKey, null);
  281:   return null;
  282: }
  283:
  284: export function hasQaScenarioPack(): boolean {
  285:   return resolveRepoPath(QA_SCENARIO_PACK_INDEX_PATH, "file") !== null;
  286: }
  287:
  288: function readTextFile(relativePath: string): string {
  289:   const resolved = resolveRepoPath(relativePath, "file");
  290:   if (!resolved) {
  291:     return "";
  292:   }
  293:   return fs.readFileSync(resolved, "utf8");
  294: }

  296: function extractQaPackYaml(content: string) {
  297:   const match = content.match(QA_PACK_FENCE_RE);
  298:   if (!match?.[1]) {
  299:     throw new Error(
  300:       `qa scenario pack missing \`\`\`yaml qa-pack fence in ${QA_SCENARIO_PACK_INDEX_PATH}`,
  301:     );
  302:   }
  303:   return match[1];
  304: }
  305:
  306: function extractQaScenarioYaml(content: string, relativePath: string) {
  307:   const match = content.match(QA_SCENARIO_FENCE_RE);
  308:   if (!match?.[1]) {
  309:     throw new Error(`qa scenario file missing \`\`\`yaml qa-scenario fence in ${relativePath}`);
  310:   }
  311:   return match[1];
  312: }
  313:
  314: function extractQaScenarioFlow(content: string, relativePath: string) {
  315:   const match = content.match(QA_FLOW_YAML_FENCE_RE);
  316:   if (!match?.[1]) {
  317:     throw new Error(`qa scenario file missing \`\`\`yaml qa-flow fence in ${relativePath}`);
  318:   }
  319:   return parseQaYamlWithContext(qaFlowSchema, YAML.parse(match[1]) as unknown, relativePath);
  320: }
  321:
  322: function formatZodIssuePath(pathLocal: PropertyKey[]) {
  323:   return pathLocal.length ? pathLocal.map(String).join(".") : "<root>";
  324: }
  325:
  326: function parseQaYamlWithContext<T>(schema: z.ZodType<T>, value: unknown, label: string): T {
  327:   const parsed = schema.safeParse(value);
  328:   if (parsed.success) {
  329:     return parsed.data;
  330:   }
  331:   const issues = parsed.error.issues
  332:     .map((issue) => `${formatZodIssuePath(issue.path)}: ${issue.message}`)
  333:     .join("; ");
  334:   throw new Error(`${label}: ${issues}`);
  335: }

  337: export function readQaScenarioPackMarkdown(): string {
  338:   const chunks = [readTextFile(QA_SCENARIO_PACK_INDEX_PATH).trim()];
  339:   for (const relativePath of listQaScenarioMarkdownPaths()) {
  340:     chunks.push(readTextFile(relativePath).trim());
  341:   }
  342:   return chunks.filter(Boolean).join("\n\n");
  343: }
  344:
  345: export function readQaScenarioPack(): QaScenarioPack {
  346:   if (qaScenarioPackCache) {
  347:     return qaScenarioPackCache;
  348:   }
  349:   const packMarkdown = readTextFile(QA_SCENARIO_PACK_INDEX_PATH).trim();
  350:   if (!packMarkdown) {
  351:     if (hasQaScenarioPack()) {
  352:       throw new Error(`empty qa scenario pack index: ${QA_SCENARIO_PACK_INDEX_PATH}`);
  353:     }
  354:     // The QA scenario pack is optional in npm distributions.  Return an empty
  355:     // pack so completion cache updates and other consumers don't crash when
  356:     // the qa/scenarios/ directory is not shipped with the package.
  357:     qaScenarioPackCache = {
  358:       version: 1,
  359:       agent: { identityMarkdown: DEFAULT_QA_AGENT_IDENTITY_MARKDOWN },
  360:       kickoffTask: "QA scenarios not available in this distribution.",
  361:       scenarios: [],
  362:     };
  363:     return qaScenarioPackCache;
  364:   }
  365:   const parsedPack = parseQaYamlWithContext(
  366:     qaScenarioPackSchema,
  367:     YAML.parse(extractQaPackYaml(packMarkdown)) as unknown,
  368:     QA_SCENARIO_PACK_INDEX_PATH,
  369:   );
  370:   const scenarios = listQaScenarioMarkdownPaths().map((relativePath) =>
  371:     (() => {
  372:       const content = readTextFile(relativePath);
  373:       const parsedScenario = parseQaYamlWithContext(
  374:         qaSeedScenarioSchema,
  375:         YAML.parse(extractQaScenarioYaml(content, relativePath)) as unknown,
  376:         relativePath,
  377:       );
  378:       const execution = parseQaYamlWithContext(
  379:         qaScenarioExecutionSchema,
  380:         parsedScenario.execution ?? {},
  381:         relativePath,
  382:       );
  383:       const flow = extractQaScenarioFlow(content, relativePath);
  384:       return {
  385:         ...parsedScenario,
  386:         sourcePath: relativePath,
  387:         execution: {
  388:           ...execution,
  389:           flow,
  390:         },
  391:       } satisfies QaSeedScenarioWithSource;
  392:     })(),
  393:   );
  394:   const seenScenarioIds = new Set<string>();
  395:   for (const scenario of scenarios) {
  396:     if (seenScenarioIds.has(scenario.id)) {
  397:       throw new Error(`duplicate qa scenario id: ${scenario.id}`);
  398:     }
  399:     seenScenarioIds.add(scenario.id);
  400:   }
  401:   qaScenarioPackCache = {
  402:     ...parsedPack,
  403:     scenarios,
  404:   };
  405:   return qaScenarioPackCache;
  406: }
  407:
  408: export function listQaScenarioMarkdownPaths(): string[] {
  409:   if (qaScenarioMarkdownPathsCache) {
  410:     return qaScenarioMarkdownPathsCache;
  411:   }
  412:   const resolved = resolveRepoPath(QA_SCENARIO_DIR_PATH, "directory");
  413:   if (!resolved) {
  414:     return [];
  415:   }
  416:   qaScenarioMarkdownPathsCache = listQaScenarioMarkdownPathsInDirectory(
  417:     resolved,
  418:     QA_SCENARIO_DIR_PATH,
  419:   ).toSorted();
  420:   return qaScenarioMarkdownPathsCache;
  421: }

  160: function normalizeQaSuiteConcurrency(
  161:   value: number | undefined,
  162:   scenarioCount: number,
  163:   defaultConcurrency = DEFAULT_QA_SUITE_CONCURRENCY,
  164: ) {
  165:   const envValue = parseStrictNonNegativeInteger(process.env.OPENCLAW_QA_SUITE_CONCURRENCY);

  170:         ? envValue
  171:         : defaultConcurrency;
  172:   return Math.max(1, Math.min(Math.floor(raw), Math.max(1, scenarioCount)));
  173: }

  175: function resolveQaSuiteWorkerStartStaggerMs(
  176:   concurrency: number,
  177:   env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env,

  186:   const parsed = parseStrictNonNegativeInteger(raw);
  187:   if (parsed === undefined) {
  188:     return DEFAULT_QA_SUITE_WORKER_START_STAGGER_MS;
  189:   }
  190:   return parsed;

  246: function isQaSuiteInfraRetryableError(error: unknown) {
  247:   const message = formatErrorMessage(error).toLowerCase();
  248:   return (
  249:     message.includes("agent.wait timeout") ||
  250:     message.includes("qa cli timed out") ||
  251:     message.includes("readyz") ||
  252:     message.includes("gateway healthy") ||
  253:     message.includes("transport ready") ||
  254:     message.includes("waiting for qa-channel ready") ||
  255:     message.includes("econnreset") ||
  256:     message.includes("econnrefused") ||
  257:     message.includes("socket hang up") ||
  258:     message.includes("could not read qa summary json") ||
  259:     message.includes("could not parse qa summary json") ||
  260:     message.includes("did not include counts.failed, counts.skipped, or scenarios[].status") ||
  261:     message.includes("did not produce report artifact")
  262:   );
  263: }

  265: async function assertQaSuiteArtifacts(result: { reportPath: string; summaryPath: string }) {
  266:   try {
  267:     await fs.access(result.reportPath);
  268:   } catch (error) {
  269:     throw new Error(
  270:       `QA suite did not produce report artifact at ${result.reportPath}: ${formatErrorMessage(error)}`,
  271:       { cause: error },
  272:     );
  273:   }
  274:   await readQaSuiteFailedOrSkippedScenarioCountFromFile(result.summaryPath);
  275: }
  276:
  277: async function runQaSuiteFromRuntimeWithInfraRetry(
  278:   params: Parameters<typeof runQaSuiteFromRuntime>[0],
  279:   maxRetries = QA_SUITE_INFRA_RETRY_LIMIT,
  280: ) {
  281:   for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt += 1) {
  282:     try {
  283:       const result = await runQaSuiteFromRuntime(params);
  284:       await assertQaSuiteArtifacts(result);
  285:       return result;
  286:     } catch (error) {
  287:       const retryable = isQaSuiteInfraRetryableError(error);
  288:       if (!retryable || attempt >= maxRetries) {
  289:         throw error;
  290:       }
  291:       process.stderr.write(
  292:         `[qa-suite] infra retry ${attempt + 1}/${maxRetries}: ${formatErrorMessage(error)}\n`,
  293:       );
  294:     }
  295:   }
  296:   throw new Error("unreachable qa suite retry state");
  297: }

// Qa Lab plugin module implements scenario flow runner behavior.
import { isRecord as isPlainObject } from "openclaw/plugin-sdk/string-coerce-runtime";
import type { QaTransportState } from "./qa-transport.js";
import type { QaScenarioFlow, QaSeedScenarioWithSource } from "./scenario-catalog.js";

type QaSuiteStep = {
  name: string;
  run: () => Promise<string | void>;
};

type QaSuiteScenarioResult = {
  name: string;
  status: "pass" | "fail";
  steps: Array<{
    name: string;
    status: "pass" | "fail" | "skip";
    details?: string;
  }>;
  details?: string;
};

type QaFlowApi = Record<string, unknown> & {
  state: QaTransportState;
  scenario: QaSeedScenarioWithSource;
  config: Record<string, unknown>;
  runScenario: (name: string, steps: QaSuiteStep[]) => Promise<QaSuiteScenarioResult>;
};

type QaFlowVars = Record<string, unknown>;

const AsyncFunction = Object.getPrototypeOf(async function () {}).constructor as new (
  ...args: string[]
) => (...fnArgs: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>;

function formatFlowDetails(details: unknown) {
  if (details === undefined) {
    return undefined;
  }
  if (typeof details === "string") {
    return details;
  }
  if (typeof details === "number" || typeof details === "boolean" || typeof details === "bigint") {
    return String(details);
  }
  return JSON.stringify(details, null, 2);
}

function getPathWithParent(
  root: Record<string, unknown>,
  ref: string,
): { parent: Record<string, unknown> | null; value: unknown } {
  const parts = ref.split(".").filter(Boolean);
  let current: unknown = root;
  let parent: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (!isPlainObject(current)) {
      return { parent: null, value: undefined };
    }
    parent = current;
    current = current[part];
  }
  return { parent, value: current };
}

function createEvalContext(api: QaFlowApi, vars: QaFlowVars) {
  return {
    ...api,
    // Optional fixture modules belong to the flow environment, not the build.
    qaImport: (specifier: string) => import(specifier),
    vars,
    ...vars,
  };
}

async function evalExpr(expr: string, api: QaFlowApi, vars: QaFlowVars) {
  const context = createEvalContext(api, vars);
  const names = Object.keys(context);
  const values = Object.values(context);
  const fn = new AsyncFunction(...names, `return (${expr});`);
  return await fn(...values);
}

function buildLambda(
  spec: { params?: string[]; expr: string; async?: boolean },
  api: QaFlowApi,
  vars: QaFlowVars,
) {
  const context = createEvalContext(api, vars);
  const names = Object.keys(context);
  const values = Object.values(context);
  const params = spec.params ?? [];
  const Factory = spec.async ? AsyncFunction : Function;
  const fn = new Factory(...names, ...params, `return (${spec.expr});`) as (
    ...fnArgs: unknown[]
  ) => unknown;
  return (...lambdaArgs: unknown[]) => fn(...values, ...lambdaArgs);
}

async function resolveValue(node: unknown, api: QaFlowApi, vars: QaFlowVars): Promise<unknown> {
  if (Array.isArray(node)) {
    return await Promise.all(node.map((entry) => resolveValue(entry, api, vars)));
  }
  if (!isPlainObject(node)) {
    return node;
  }
  const keys = Object.keys(node);
  if (keys.length === 1 && typeof node.ref === "string") {
    return getPathWithParent(createEvalContext(api, vars), node.ref).value;
  }
  if (keys.length === 1 && typeof node.expr === "string") {
    return await evalExpr(node.expr, api, vars);
  }
  if (keys.length === 1 && isPlainObject(node.lambda) && typeof node.lambda.expr === "string") {
    return buildLambda(
      {
        expr: node.lambda.expr,
        params: Array.isArray(node.lambda.params)
          ? node.lambda.params.filter((entry): entry is string => typeof entry === "string")
          : [],
        async: node.lambda.async === true,

exec

    1: // Qa Lab plugin module implements cli paths behavior.
    2: import fs from "node:fs/promises";
    3: import path from "node:path";
    4: import { assertNoSymlinkParents, pathScope } from "openclaw/plugin-sdk/security-runtime";
    5:
    6: export function resolveRepoRelativeOutputDir(repoRoot: string, outputDir?: string) {
    7:   if (!outputDir) {
    8:     return undefined;
    9:   }
   10:   if (path.isAbsolute(outputDir)) {
   11:     throw new Error("--output-dir must be a relative path inside the repo root.");
   12:   }
   13:   const resolved = pathScope(repoRoot, { label: "repo root" }).resolve(outputDir);
   14:   if (!resolved.ok) {
   15:     throw new Error("--output-dir must stay within the repo root.");
   16:   }
   17:   return resolved.path;
   18: }
   19:
   20: async function resolveNearestExistingPath(targetPath: string) {
   21:   let current = path.resolve(targetPath);
   22:   while (true) {
   23:     try {
   24:       await fs.lstat(current);
   25:       return current;
   26:     } catch (error) {
   27:       if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== "ENOENT") {
   28:         throw error;
   29:       }
   30:     }
   31:     const parent = path.dirname(current);
   32:     if (parent === current) {
   33:       throw new Error(`failed to resolve existing path for ${targetPath}`);
   34:     }
   35:     current = parent;
   36:   }
   37: }
   38:
   39: function assertRepoRelativePath(repoRoot: string, targetPath: string, label: string) {
   40:   const relative = path.relative(repoRoot, targetPath);
   41:   if (relative.startsWith("..") || path.isAbsolute(relative)) {
   42:     throw new Error(`${label} must stay within the repo root.`);
   43:   }
   44:   return relative;
   45: }
   46:
   47: async function assertNoSymlinkSegments(repoRoot: string, targetPath: string, label: string) {
   48:   assertRepoRelativePath(repoRoot, targetPath, label);
   49:   try {
   50:     await assertNoSymlinkParents({
   51:       rootDir: repoRoot,
   52:       targetPath,
   53:       messagePrefix: label,
   54:     });
   55:   } catch (error) {
   56:     if (error instanceof Error && error.message.includes("symlink")) {
   57:       throw new Error(`${label} must not traverse symlinks.`, { cause: error });
   58:     }
   59:     throw error;
   60:   }
   61: }
   62:
   63: export async function assertRepoBoundPath(repoRoot: string, targetPath: string, label: string) {
   64:   const repoRootResolved = path.resolve(repoRoot);
   65:   const targetResolved = path.resolve(targetPath);
   66:   assertRepoRelativePath(repoRootResolved, targetResolved, label);
   67:   await assertNoSymlinkSegments(repoRootResolved, targetResolved, label);
   68:   const repoRootReal = await fs.realpath(repoRootResolved);
   69:   const nearestExistingPath = await resolveNearestExistingPath(targetResolved);
   70:   const nearestExistingReal = await fs.realpath(nearestExistingPath);
   71:   assertRepoRelativePath(repoRootReal, nearestExistingReal, label);
   72:   return targetResolved;
   73: }
   74:
   75: export async function ensureRepoBoundDirectory(
   76:   repoRoot: string,
   77:   targetDir: string,
   78:   label: string,
   79:   opts?: { mode?: number },
   80: ) {
   81:   await assertNoSymlinkSegments(path.resolve(repoRoot), path.resolve(targetDir), label);
   82:   const result = await pathScope(repoRoot, { label }).ensureDir(targetDir, { mode: opts?.mode });
   83:   if (!result.ok) {
   84:     throw new Error(`${label} must stay within the repo root.`);
   85:   }
   86:   return result.path;
   87: }

const QA_AGENTIC_PARITY_PACK = "agentic";

    title: "Model switch with tool continuity",
    countsTowardValidToolCallRate: true,

    title: "Image understanding from attachment",
    countsTowardValidToolCallRate: false,
  },
  {
    id: "compaction-retry-mutating-tool",
    title: "Compaction retry after mutating tool",
    countsTowardValidToolCallRate: true,
  },
  {
    id: "subagent-handoff",
    title: "Subagent handoff",
    countsTowardValidToolCallRate: true,
  },
  {
    id: "subagent-fanout-synthesis",
    title: "Subagent fanout synthesis",
    countsTowardValidToolCallRate: true,
  },
  {
    id: "subagent-stale-child-links",
    title: "Subagent stale child links",
    countsTowardValidToolCallRate: false,
  },
  {
    id: "memory-recall",
    title: "Memory recall after context switch",
    countsTowardValidToolCallRate: false,
  },
  {
    id: "thread-memory-isolation",
    title: "Thread memory isolation",
    countsTowardValidToolCallRate: true,
  },
  {
    id: "config-restart-capability-flip",
    title: "Config restart capability flip",
    countsTowardValidToolCallRate: true,
  },
  {
    id: "instruction-followthrough-repo-contract",
    title: "Instruction followthrough repo contract",
    countsTowardValidToolCallRate: true,
  },
] as const;

export const QA_AGENTIC_PARITY_SCENARIO_IDS = QA_AGENTIC_PARITY_SCENARIOS.map(({ id }) => id);
export const QA_AGENTIC_PARITY_SCENARIO_TITLES = QA_AGENTIC_PARITY_SCENARIOS.map(
  ({ title }) => title,
);
export const QA_AGENTIC_PARITY_TOOL_BACKED_SCENARIO_TITLES = QA_AGENTIC_PARITY_SCENARIOS.filter(
  ({ countsTowardValidToolCallRate }) => countsTowardValidToolCallRate,
).map(({ title }) => title);

export function resolveQaParityPackScenarioIds(params: {
  parityPack?: string;
  scenarioIds?: string[];
}): string[] {
  const normalizedPack = params.parityPack?.trim().toLowerCase();
  const explicitScenarioIds = uniqueStrings(params.scenarioIds ?? []);
  if (!normalizedPack) {
    return explicitScenarioIds;
  }
  if (normalizedPack !== QA_AGENTIC_PARITY_PACK) {
    throw new Error(
      `--parity-pack must be "${QA_AGENTIC_PARITY_PACK}", got "${params.parityPack}"`,
    );
  }

  return uniqueStrings([...explicitScenarioIds, ...QA_AGENTIC_PARITY_SCENARIO_IDS]);
}

// Derives plugin SDK entrypoint sets, package exports, and dist artifact paths.
import deprecatedBarrelPluginSdkSubpathList from "./plugin-sdk-deprecated-barrel-subpaths.json" with { type: "json" };
import deprecatedPublicPluginSdkSubpathList from "./plugin-sdk-deprecated-public-subpaths.json" with { type: "json" };
import pluginSdkEntryList from "./plugin-sdk-entrypoints.json" with { type: "json" };
import privateLocalOnlyPluginSdkSubpathList from "./plugin-sdk-private-local-only-subpaths.json" with { type: "json" };

/** All plugin SDK entrypoints, including the package root index. */
export const pluginSdkEntrypoints = [...pluginSdkEntryList];

/** Plugin SDK subpath entrypoints, excluding the package root index. */
export const pluginSdkSubpaths = pluginSdkEntrypoints.filter((entry) => entry !== "index");

const privateLocalOnlyPluginSdkSubpathSet = new Set(
  privateLocalOnlyPluginSdkSubpathList.filter(
    (entry) => typeof entry === "string" && !entry.includes("/"),
  ),
);

/** Private plugin SDK entrypoints that are built locally but not exported publicly. */
export const privateLocalOnlyPluginSdkEntrypoints = pluginSdkSubpaths.filter((entry) =>
  privateLocalOnlyPluginSdkSubpathSet.has(entry),
);

/** Public plugin SDK entrypoints that appear in package exports. */
export const publicPluginSdkEntrypoints = pluginSdkEntrypoints.filter(
  (entry) => entry === "index" || !privateLocalOnlyPluginSdkSubpathSet.has(entry),
);

/** Public plugin SDK subpaths, excluding the package root index. */
export const publicPluginSdkSubpaths = publicPluginSdkEntrypoints.filter(
  (entry) => entry !== "index",
);

/** Deprecated public plugin SDK subpaths kept for compatibility. */
export const deprecatedPublicPluginSdkEntrypoints = publicPluginSdkSubpaths.filter((entry) =>
  deprecatedPublicPluginSdkSubpathList.includes(entry),
);

/** Deprecated barrel entrypoints that should not be expanded further. */
export const deprecatedBarrelPluginSdkEntrypoints = pluginSdkSubpaths.filter((entry) =>
  deprecatedBarrelPluginSdkSubpathList.includes(entry),
);

/** Build tsdown entry source paths for plugin SDK entrypoints. */
export function buildPluginSdkEntrySources(entries = pluginSdkEntrypoints) {
  return Object.fromEntries(entries.map((entry) => [entry, `src/plugin-sdk/${entry}.ts`]));
}

/** Build package export metadata for public plugin SDK entrypoints. */
export function buildPluginSdkPackageExports() {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    publicPluginSdkEntrypoints.map((entry) => [
      entry === "index" ? "./plugin-sdk" : `./plugin-sdk/${entry}`,
      {
        types: `./dist/plugin-sdk/${entry}.d.ts`,
        default: `./dist/plugin-sdk/${entry}.js`,
      },
    ]),
  );
}

/** List public plugin SDK dist artifacts expected in package output. */
export function listPluginSdkDistArtifacts() {
  return publicPluginSdkEntrypoints.flatMap((entry) => [
    `dist/plugin-sdk/${entry}.js`,
    `dist/plugin-sdk/${entry}.d.ts`,
  ]);
}

/** List private local-only plugin SDK dist artifacts expected after local builds. */
export function listPrivateLocalOnlyPluginSdkDistArtifacts() {
  return privateLocalOnlyPluginSdkEntrypoints.flatMap((entry) => [
    `dist/plugin-sdk/${entry}.js`,
    `dist/plugin-sdk/${entry}.d.ts`,
  ]);
}

  473: async function readQaCredentialPayloadFile(filePath: string) {
  474:   const text = await fs.readFile(filePath, "utf8");
  475:   let payload: unknown;
  476:   try {
  477:     payload = JSON.parse(text) as unknown;
  478:   } catch (error) {
  479:     throw new Error(`Payload file must contain valid JSON: ${formatErrorMessage(error)}`, {
  480:       cause: error,
  481:     });
  482:   }
  483:   if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object" || Array.isArray(payload)) {
  484:     throw new Error("Payload file JSON must be an object.");
  485:   }
  486:   return payload as Record<string, unknown>;
  487: }

  496: function printQaCredentialListTable(credentials: QaCredentialRecord[]) {
  497:   if (credentials.length === 0) {
  498:     process.stdout.write("No credentials matched.\n");
  499:     return;
  500:   }
  501:   const rows = credentials.map((credential) => ({
  502:     credentialId: credential.credentialId,
  503:     fingerprint: credential.credentialFingerprint ?? "",
  504:     kind: credential.kind,
  505:     status: credential.status,
  506:     leased: formatQaCredentialLeaseState(credential),
  507:     note: credential.note ?? "",
  508:   }));
  509:   const idWidth = Math.max("credentialId".length, ...rows.map((row) => row.credentialId.length));
  510:   const fingerprintWidth = Math.max(
  511:     "fingerprint".length,
  512:     ...rows.map((row) => row.fingerprint.length),
  513:   );
  514:   const kindWidth = Math.max("kind".length, ...rows.map((row) => row.kind.length));
  515:   const statusWidth = Math.max("status".length, ...rows.map((row) => row.status.length));
  516:   const leaseWidth = Math.max("leased".length, ...rows.map((row) => row.leased.length));
  517:   process.stdout.write(
  518:     `${"credentialId".padEnd(idWidth)}  ${"fingerprint".padEnd(fingerprintWidth)}  ${"kind".padEnd(kindWidth)}  ${"status".padEnd(statusWidth)}  ${"leased".padEnd(leaseWidth)}  note\n`,
  519:   );
  520:   for (const row of rows) {
  521:     process.stdout.write(
  522:       `${row.credentialId.padEnd(idWidth)}  ${row.fingerprint.padEnd(fingerprintWidth)}  ${row.kind.padEnd(kindWidth)}  ${row.status.padEnd(statusWidth)}  ${row.leased.padEnd(leaseWidth)}  ${row.note}\n`,
  523:     );
  524:   }
  525: }

// Qa Lab plugin module implements suite launch behavior.
import type { QaSuiteRunParams } from "./suite.js";

async function loadQaLabServerRuntime() {
  const { startQaLabServer } = await import("./lab-server.js");
  return startQaLabServer;
}

export async function runQaSuiteFromRuntime(...args: [QaSuiteRunParams?]) {
  const { runQaSuite } = await import("./suite.js");
  const params = args[0];
  return await runQaSuite({
    ...params,
    startLab: params?.startLab ?? (await loadQaLabServerRuntime()),
  });
}

// Qa Lab plugin module implements bus server behavior.
import { createServer, type IncomingMessage, type Server, type ServerResponse } from "node:http";
import { formatErrorMessage } from "openclaw/plugin-sdk/error-runtime";
import {
  isRequestBodyLimitError,
  readRequestBodyWithLimit,
  requestBodyErrorToText,
} from "openclaw/plugin-sdk/webhook-ingress";
import { normalizeAccountId, resolveQaBusPollStartCursor } from "./bus-queries.js";
import type { QaBusState } from "./bus-state.js";
import type {
  QaBusCreateThreadInput,
  QaBusDeleteMessageInput,
  QaBusEditMessageInput,
  QaBusInboundMessageInput,
  QaBusOutboundMessageInput,
  QaBusPollInput,
  QaBusReactToMessageInput,
  QaBusReadMessageInput,
  QaBusSearchMessagesInput,
  QaBusWaitForInput,
} from "./runtime-api.js";

const QA_HTTP_JSON_MAX_BODY_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;
const QA_HTTP_JSON_BODY_TIMEOUT_MS = 5_000;

export async function readQaJsonBody(req: IncomingMessage): Promise<unknown> {
  const text = (
    await readRequestBodyWithLimit(req, {
      maxBytes: QA_HTTP_JSON_MAX_BODY_BYTES,
      timeoutMs: QA_HTTP_JSON_BODY_TIMEOUT_MS,
    })
  ).trim();
  return text ? (JSON.parse(text) as unknown) : {};
}

export function writeJson(res: ServerResponse, statusCode: number, body: unknown) {
  const payload = JSON.stringify(body);
  res.writeHead(statusCode, {
    "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
    "content-length": Buffer.byteLength(payload),
  });
  res.end(payload);
}

export function writeError(res: ServerResponse, statusCode: number, error: unknown) {
  writeJson(res, statusCode, {
    error: formatErrorMessage(error),
  });
}

export function writeQaRequestBodyLimitError(res: ServerResponse, error: unknown): boolean {
  if (!isRequestBodyLimitError(error)) {
    return false;
  }
  writeError(res, error.statusCode, requestBodyErrorToText(error.code));
  return true;
}

export async function closeQaHttpServer(server: Server): Promise<void> {
  let forceCloseTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
  try {
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close((error) => (error ? reject(error) : resolve()));
      server.closeIdleConnections?.();
      forceCloseTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        server.closeAllConnections?.();
      }, 250);
      forceCloseTimer.unref();
    });
  } finally {
    if (forceCloseTimer) {
      clearTimeout(forceCloseTimer);
    }
  }
}

export async function handleQaBusRequest(params: {
  req: IncomingMessage;
  res: ServerResponse;
  state: QaBusState;
}): Promise<boolean> {
  const method = params.req.method ?? "GET";
  const url = new URL(params.req.url ?? "/", "http://127.0.0.1");

  if (method === "GET" && url.pathname === "/health") {
    writeJson(params.res, 200, { ok: true });
    return true;
  }

  if (method === "GET" && url.pathname === "/v1/state") {
    writeJson(params.res, 200, params.state.getSnapshot());
    return true;
  }

  if (!url.pathname.startsWith("/v1/")) {
    return false;
  }

  if (method !== "POST") {
    writeError(params.res, 405, "method not allowed");
    return true;
  }

  try {
    const body = (await readQaJsonBody(params.req)) as Record<string, unknown>;
    switch (url.pathname) {
      case "/v1/reset":
        params.state.reset();
        writeJson(params.res, 200, { ok: true });
        return true;
      case "/v1/inbound/message":
        writeJson(params.res, 200, {
          message: params.state.addInboundMessage(body as unknown as QaBusInboundMessageInput),
        });
        return true;
      case "/v1/outbound/message":
        writeJson(params.res, 200, {
          message: params.state.addOutboundMessage(body as unknown as QaBusOutboundMessageInput),
        });
        return true;
      case "/v1/actions/thread-create":
        writeJson(params.res, 200, {
          thread: params.state.createThread(body as unknown as QaBusCreateThreadInput),
        });
        return true;
      case "/v1/actions/react":
        writeJson(params.res, 200, {
          message: params.state.reactToMessage(body as unknown as QaBusReactToMessageInput),
        });
        return true;
      case "/v1/actions/edit":
        writeJson(params.res, 200, {
          message: params.state.editMessage(body as unknown as QaBusEditMessageInput),
        });
        return true;
      case "/v1/actions/delete":
        writeJson(params.res, 200, {
          message: params.state.deleteMessage(body as unknown as QaBusDeleteMessageInput),
        });
        return true;
      case "/v1/actions/read":
        writeJson(params.res, 200, {
          message: params.state.readMessage(body as unknown as QaBusReadMessageInput),
        });
        return true;
      case "/v1/actions/search":
        writeJson(params.res, 200, {
          messages: params.state.searchMessages(body as unknown as QaBusSearchMessagesInput),
        });
        return true;
      case "/v1/poll": {
        const input = body as unknown as QaBusPollInput;
        const timeoutMs = Math.max(0, Math.min(input.timeoutMs ?? 0, 30_000));
        const accountId = normalizeAccountId(input.accountId);
        const initial = params.state.poll(input);
        const effectiveStartCursor = resolveQaBusPollStartCursor({
          currentCursor: initial.cursor,
          requestedCursor: input.cursor,
        });
        if (initial.events.length > 0 || timeoutMs === 0) {
          writeJson(params.res, 200, initial);
          return true;
        }
        try {
          await params.state.waitForCursorAdvance(effectiveStartCursor, timeoutMs, (snapshot) => {
            return snapshot.events.some(
              (event) => event.accountId === accountId && event.cursor > effectiveStartCursor,
            );
          });
        } catch {
          // timeout ok for long-poll
        }
        writeJson(params.res, 200, params.state.poll(input));
        return true;
      }
      case "/v1/wait":
        writeJson(params.res, 200, {
          match: await params.state.waitFor(body as unknown as QaBusWaitForInput),
        });
        return true;
      default:
        writeError(params.res, 404, "not found");
        return true;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    if (writeQaRequestBodyLimitError(params.res, error)) {
      return true;
    }
    writeError(params.res, 400, error);
    return true;
  }
}

export function createQaBusServer(state: QaBusState): Server {
  return createServer((req, res) => {
    void (async () => {
      const handled = await handleQaBusRequest({ req, res, state });
      if (!handled) {
        writeError(res, 404, "not found");
      }
    })();
  });
}

export async function startQaBusServer(params: { state: QaBusState; port?: number }) {
  const server = createQaBusServer(params.state);
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    server.once("error", reject);
    server.listen(params.port ?? 0, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve());
  });
  const address = server.address();
  if (!address || typeof address === "string") {
    throw new Error("qa-bus failed to bind");
  }
  return {
    server,
    port: address.port,
    baseUrl: `http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}`,
    async stop() {
      await closeQaHttpServer(server);
    },
  };
}

For each package path, `dependencyPath = path.join(path.dirname(packagePath), "node_modules")`. For top-level package.json, dirname is ""? `path.dirname("package.json")` on Windows Node returns ".". This tries to create symlink at projection root whose target is the source root itself. On Windows, `fs.symlink(target, projection, 'junction')` may fail EEXIST because projection exists. Or maybe Node's fs.symlink with junction target and path existing returns EPERM/EEXIST. This is concrete bug: negative controls will always fail at first package path because it attempts to symlink projection root to original root. Need verify. `path.dirname(packagePath)` for packagePath "package.json" in Node path.win32 returns "."; yes. `dependencyPath` becomes ".". `fs.stat(path.join(root, "."))` returns source root directory, so `fs.symlink(root, projection, 'junction')` with destination already exists. On Windows symlink existing path => EEXIST. On POSIX, type "dir" and destination exists => EEXIST. So runNegativeControls crashes before controls. This is P1 because negative controls required. Could fix by special-case package root or only create node_modules symlink, not root. The intended operation should skip package.json whose dirname is "." or create root/node_modules. It doesn't.
